items.title: 7700→8250！大幅調高標普年底目標逾一成 華爾街大多頭：美科技股正處於「打折階段」
items.title_en: 7700→8250! S&P Year‑End Target Raised Over 10% as Wall Street Bulls Say Tech Stocks Are in a “Discount Phase”
paras: Yardeni Research 總裁 Ed Yardeni 近日接受《CNBC》訪問時將標普 500 今年目標價從 7700 點上調至 8250 點，並把今年 EPS 預期由 310 美元調升至 330 美元。
他直言，首季財報「火爆」，分析師獲利估值上修速度前所未見，今年日曆年獲利增速共識約 23%，「我本來不夠看多」。
Yardeni 強調，本輪上漲由企業現金流與利潤創高驅動，而非華府政策或投機 FOMO，拜登基建與特朗普放鬆監管雙輪助推，生產率跳升抵銷油價與工資壓力，嬰兒潮退休族 89 兆美元淨資產成股資金源頭。
Yardeni 還預估，AI 淨增就業，標普本十年末有望挑戰 10000 點。
那斯達克 100 指數四個交易日累漲 9.3%，預期 12 個月本益比 22.3 倍，Yardeni 稱對高成長賽道「相對低廉」。
華爾街同聲看多反彈持續，美光、Alphabet 預期本益比仍低於五年均值，資金從槓桿 ETF 撤出轉進個股。
部分策略師提示，漲勢正從美股「7 巨頭」向半導體、記憶體、電力設備擴散，AI 資本開支外溢決定寬基輪動深度。
但 Yardeni 認為，仍須留意估值集中與地緣局勢回馬槍的風險。標普年初以來漲 8%，若消費韌性失效或美債長端利率再飆，8250 將成壓力測試；但 Yardeni 判斷，只要經濟不衰退、獲利上修不斷電，回撤即買點。
paras_en: Yardeni Research President Ed Yardeni told CNBC that he is raising his S&P 500 target for this year from 7,700 points to 8,250 points and lifting his earnings‑per‑share forecast from $310 to $330.

He said the first‑quarter earnings were “explosive,” and analysts are upgrading profit estimates at a speed never seen before, with consensus earnings growth for the calendar year around 23%, “I was not bullish enough originally.”

Yardeni stressed that the current rally is driven by strong corporate cash flow and profit growth, not by Washington policy or speculative FOMO; the Biden infrastructure plan and Trump‑era deregulation are both helping, productivity gains are offsetting oil‑price and wage pressures, and the $89 trillion net assets of retiring baby‑boomers are a source of equity capital.
He also projected that AI‑driven net job creation could push the S&P 500 to challenge the 10,000‑point level by the end of the decade.
The Nasdaq‑100 has risen 9.3% over four trading days and is expected to trade at a 12‑month forward P/E of 22.3×, which Yardeni says is “relatively cheap” for a high‑growth segment.

Wall Street broadly expects the rebound to continue, with Micron and Alphabet still trading at P/E ratios below their five‑year averages, and money flowing out of leveraged ETFs into individual stocks.

Some strategists note that the rally is spreading from the U.S. “big‑seven” stocks to semiconductors, memory chips and power‑equipment firms, as AI‑related capital spending spill‑over determines the depth of the broad market rotation.

Yardeni cautions that valuation concentration and geopolitical flash‑points remain risks. The S&P has risen about 8% since the start of the year; if consumer resilience fades or long‑term U.S. Treasury yields spike again, the 8,250 target could become a stress test, but Yardeni judges that as long as the economy avoids recession and earnings upgrades keep coming, pullbacks will be buying opportunities.

items.title: 突破7兆！DeepSeek V4 Flash單周調用量全球登頂
items.title_en: Breaking 7 Trillion! DeepSeek V4 Flash Tops Global Weekly Call Volume
paras: 多模型聚合平台 OpenRouter 發布的全球 AI 大模型調用量周榜單（7 月 27 日至 8 月 2 日）顯示，DeepSeek V4 Flash 以 7.22 兆 Token 的調用量位居第一。
另據開源項目團隊 OpenCode 發文，其平台上 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的調用量大幅飆升，僅 8 月 1 日一天，模型單日處理達 8 兆 Token。其中 5 兆為免費試用額度消耗，3 兆為開發者透過 OpenCode 平台付費使用。
據《界面新聞》5 日（周三）報導，OpenRouter 的數據顯示，上周全球 AI 大模型總調用量為 56.8 兆 Token，較前周下滑 2.07%。
上榜的 AI 大模型中，中國 AI 大模型周調用量達 28.13 兆 Token，下降 14.76%。同期美國 AI 大模型周調用量為 4.38 兆 Token，激增 87.18%。中國大模型周調用量已連續十四周超過美國，穩居全球首位。
至於 OpenRouter 本周榜單，目前 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423 仍排在首位，調用量為 6.92 兆 Token。
該模型最早於今年 4 月推出，主打平衡推理速度、長上下文能力與調用成本，主要面向開發者、商用企業提供高吞吐推理服務。
排在第二名的是小米 (01810-HK) MiMo-V2.5，周調用量 5.1 兆 Token，較前周銳減 52%，市場熱度有所回落。
小米這款模型於今年 4 月 23 日正式公測，4 月底完成全系列開源。其採用混合專家 MoE 架構，總參數突破兆級別，激活參數 42B，標配 100 萬 Token 超長上下文窗口，同時覆蓋文本、語音、圖像全模態交互。
目前第三名是騰訊 (00700-HK) 自研大模型混元 Hy3，調用規模 5.01 兆 Token。Hy3 曾是 7 月 26 日所在周榜單增長勢頭最猛的模型，彼時周調用量 3.94 兆 Tokens，增幅超過 999%。
Hy3 於 7 月 6 日正式開源，總參數 295B、單次推理僅激活 21B 參數。其採用快慢思考融合架構，最大支援 256K 上下文，代碼生成、智慧交互能力大幅迭代。
paras_en: The multi‑model aggregation platform OpenRouter’s global AI large‑model weekly usage ranking (July 27 – August 2) shows DeepSeek V4 Flash leading the list with 7.22 trillion tokens called.

According to a post by the open‑source project team OpenCode, DeepSeek V4 Flash’s usage on their platform surged dramatically, processing 8 trillion tokens in a single day on August 1, of which 5 trillion were consumed by the free‑trial quota and 3 trillion were paid usage by developers through the OpenCode platform.

As reported by Jiemian News on Wednesday, the 5th, OpenRouter’s data indicate that total global AI large‑model usage last week amounted to 56.8 trillion tokens, a 2.07 % decline from the previous week.

Among the models on the list, Chinese AI large models accounted for 28.13 trillion tokens weekly, down 14.76 %, while U.S. AI large models recorded 4.38 trillion tokens, up 87.18 %. Chinese model usage has now exceeded U.S. usage for fourteen consecutive weeks, keeping China at the top globally.
For this week’s OpenRouter ranking, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423 remains in first place with 6.92 trillion tokens called.

The model was first launched in April of this year, emphasizing a balance of inference speed, long‑context capability, and cost, and is primarily aimed at developers and commercial enterprises that need high‑throughput inference services.
In second place is Xiaomi (01810‑HK) MiMo‑V2.5, with a weekly call volume of 5.1 trillion tokens, a sharp 52 % drop from the previous week, indicating a cooling of market enthusiasm.

Xiaomi’s model entered public beta on April 23 and completed full‑series open‑sourcing at the end of April. It uses a mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) architecture, exceeds a trillion parameters overall, activates 42 billion parameters, comes standard with a 1 million‑token ultra‑long context window, and supports text, speech, and image multimodal interaction.

Currently in third place is Tencent (00700‑HK) self‑developed large model HunYuan Hy3, with a usage scale of 5.01 trillion tokens. Hy3 was the fastest‑growing model on the July 26 weekly chart, then posting 3.94 trillion tokens and a growth rate of over 999 %.

Hy3 was open‑sourced on July 6, has a total of 295 billion parameters and activates only 21 billion parameters per inference. It employs a fast‑slow thinking fusion architecture, supports up to 256 K context length, and features major upgrades in code generation and intelligent interaction capabilities.

items.title: 元樟生技 SeepPlug™ 精準孔徑技術跨足中草藥領域 助力台灣中藥材在地種植品質升級
paras: 興櫃生技公司元樟生物科技（TPEx：6864）今年正式將旗下核心平台技術 SeepPlug™ 精準 孔徑栽培介質，導入中草藥種苗與田間栽培應用領域。台灣科學中藥領導品牌順天堂藥廠總經 理莊武璋已於 7 月 20 日親自參訪元樟生技合作農場，就中藥材在地種植的技術痛點與雙方可 能的技術協作展開交流，為兩家分屬生物材料與漢方製藥領域的公司開啟對話。
中藥材在地化的四道關卡：品系溯源、健康種苗、栽培管理與品質規範

台灣中藥材長期面臨供應鏈脆弱的結構性問題。產業普遍認知，約有近九成中藥材仰賴海外進 口，一旦地緣情勢緊張或發生疫情，價格劇烈波動與斷貨風險便隨之而來；2003 年 SARS 期 間金銀花價格飆漲十至二十倍，2020-2023 年 Covid-19 期間多項藥材上漲 5~10 倍，並延續 至 2025 年，為中醫藥經營帶來沉重壓力。與此同時，進口藥材在來源透明度、重金屬與農藥 殘留、品系真偽、微生物污染等面向難以完全掌握，成為中藥現代化與國際外銷的隱形門檻。
在地種植被視為解方，但難度遠高於一般作物栽培。誠如順天堂歷經逾十年才成功以仿生栽培 穩定培育出具活性成分的流蘇石斛，藥用植物一旦產地與生長條件改變，可能導致有效成分流 失、藥材失去功效。中藥材在地化真正的挑戰，主要涵蓋四個環節：品系來源是否正確合法且 可追溯、健康種苗能否穩定量產、田間栽培至採收的品質能否一致管理，以及加工或炮製後的 有效成分與品質能否符合國內外相關規範。
SeepPlug™ 的技術對位：從介質升級為品質管理工具

元樟生技 SeepPlug™ 的核心價值，正是將這前三個環節從「經驗依賴」轉化為「工程可控」。 SeepPlug™ 為工程化栽培介質，原料來源可追溯、規格標準化，並可依不同應用需求進行潔 淨化或滅菌處理，有助降低介質端的污染風險，並支持中藥材對來源透明、重金屬、農藥殘留 及微生物等項目的品質管理要求。其 PoroVance™ 孔隙技術與可調控電解質特性，能為不同 藥用作物客製化根區的水氣與養分環境，滿足石斛、薑科等高敏感作物對 pH 與 EC 的精準需 求，協助健康種苗穩定成型。介質的規格化與可拋棄特性，亦同步降低連作障礙與立枯病等土 傳病害風險，讓田間栽培到採收的品質波動大幅收斂。
元樟生技現階段鎖定的中藥材應用標的，包含台灣流蘇石斛、白及與薑科作物三類。這三類作 物分別代表瀕危管制藥材的人工栽培溯源需求、高經濟價值藥材的種苗量產需求，以及大宗常 用藥材的田間品質一致性需求，構成 SeepPlug™ 中草藥應用的技術驗證主軸。
從栽培介質到生技平台：SeepPlug™拓展中藥材應用版圖

對元樟生技而言，跨入中草藥領域的意義在於重新定義 SeepPlug™ 的技術定位。SeepPlug™ 源自醫療級傷口敷料的 PoroVance™ 精準孔徑工程平台，其價值不僅止於作為栽培基材，更 是一項能協助中藥廠進行品系管理、健康種苗培育及田間栽培標準化的源頭品質管理工具，並 為後續採收、加工及品質評估提供更一致的藥材基礎。當中藥材品質能從源頭被工程化地掌握， 台灣中藥產業長期受制於海外進口、來源難掌握、重金屬與農藥殘留等結構性難題，便有了系 統性突破的技術基礎。
適逢順天堂藥廠創立 80 週年，其長年推動中藥材在地種植、以科學實證強化漢方現代化的努 力，為台灣中藥產業樹立標竿。元樟生技期望以 SeepPlug™ 的精準孔徑技術，成為支持中藥 廠在地化升級的協力力量，共同推動台灣中藥材邁向自主、可控、可溯源的下一階段。
關於元樟生物科技（AMS BioteQ，TPEx：6864）
元樟生物科技為功能性生物材料平台公司，核心技術 PoroVance™ 精準孔徑工程源自醫療級發泡敷料 技術，橫跨農業栽培介質（SeepPlug™）、醫療傷口敷料（SIPSIP®）與功能性保養（Lumière d"Art） 等應用領域。

items.title: 【0806台股盤前】外本比排行策略鎖定【鈺創、宏致、中光電】，光通訊與利基型記憶體狂飆噴發！加權爆量大漲 1250 點放量突破 1.19 兆 外資大買 903 億創近期新高
paras: 台股前一交易日 (8/5）在美股科技股強勢激勵下，呈現爆量急衝格局。早盤在台積電與權值股強勢跳空領軍下開高衝上 43,809.83 點後一路向上拉升，盤中最高探至 44,980.31 點近 4.5 萬點關卡；終場大漲 1,250.94 點 (+2.88%），收在 44,611.60 點，集中市場成交金額爆量放大至 1 兆 1,874.97 億元 (約 1.19 兆元）。櫃買指數 (OTC）同步勁揚 8.72 點 (+2.33%），收在 383.75 點。
一、盤勢分析

受惠美股 AI 權值股強勢狂飆，集中市場前一交易日三大法人合計大舉買超 1,004.06 億元。其中外資法人單日大舉買超 903.08 億元，創下近期單日買超金額最高紀錄，展現強烈回補台股權值股決心；投信法人買超 86.38 億元，自營商買超 14.57 億元 (自行買賣賣超 23.27 億元、避險買超 37.84 億元）。櫃買市場三大法人於上櫃股票合計賣超 55.16 億元 (外資賣超 29.80 億元，投信賣超 14.68 億元）。大盤展現價增量銳氣勢，短線持續維持強勢震盪上攻態勢。
二、強勢產業

利基型記憶體 IC 族群 (平均上漲 +8.63%）：受惠國際三大記憶體晶片製造巨頭產能全面轉向 HBM 與高階 DDR5，致使 DDR3/DDR4 與 Flash 現貨與合約報價急遽上揚。邊緣 AI 裝置與消費電子備貨旺季啟動，鈺創 (5351）連續 4 個交易日強勢亮燈漲停收 96.5 元、晶豪科 (3006-TW）大漲 8.97% 收 237 元、愛普 *(6531-TW）大漲 6.70% 收 414 元。

砷化鎵與光通訊族群 (平均上漲 +7.47%）：AI 伺服器帶動高速光傳輸 (CPO / 800G / 1.6T）需求爆發，加上智慧型手機新機 PA 功率放大器備貨旺季啟動，產業利用率大幅提升。波若威 (3163-TW）大漲 9.84% 收 212 元、全新 (2455-TW）大漲 7.88% 收 198.5 元、宏捷科 (8086-TW）大漲 6.97% 收 153.5 元、環宇 - KY(4991-TW）大漲 9.77% 收 118 元。
銅箔基板 (CCL) 族群 (平均上漲 +6.60%）：受惠高階 AI 伺服器與交換機採用高層數、大面積材料，Ultra Low-DK 銅箔基板消耗量倍增，驅動 ASP 與毛利率增長。聯茂 (6213-TW）強攻漲停收 138.5 元、台燿 (6274-TW）大漲 7.04% 收 228 元、台光電 (2383-TW）大漲 5.38% 收 685 元。
機器人與自動化族群 (平均上漲 +6.54%）：受惠全球機器人展即將登場及人形機器人生態系合作題材，工業自動化急單湧現。上銀(2049) 開高強攻漲停收 315 元、所羅門 (2359-TW) 大漲 8.84% 收 178.5 元、亞德客 - KY(1590-TW)大漲 4.09% 收 1,145 元重回千元大關。
三、弱勢產業
織布與紡織成衣族群 (平均 -0.83%)：歐美品牌客戶下單轉趨審慎，紡織上游面臨淡季拉貨放緩壓力，加上電子股資金排擠，族群呈現拉回整理。儒鴻(1476-TW) 下跌 1.45% 收 542 元、南紡 (1440-TW) 下跌 0.84% 收 17.8 元。
貨櫃航運族群 (平均 -0.69%)：SCFI 運價高檔微幅修正，市場消化地中海與紅海繞道效應，運價調漲催化劑淡化致使族群走勢平淡。長榮(2603-TW) 微跌 0.68% 收 218.5 元、陽明 (2609-TW) 下跌 0.81% 收 73.2 元、萬海 (2615-TW) 微跌 0.58% 收 86.1 元。

paras: 南韓預託結算院 SEIBRO 平台周三 (5 日) 數據顯示，截至周一 (3 日)，南韓的美股投資人單日淨賣超費半指數 3 倍槓桿 ETF(SOXL) 共 6.6439 億美元 (約 9486 億韓元)，規模相當於 7 月全月淨買超 37.8586 億美元的 17.5%，但本周前兩日合計仍淨賣出 6.0735 億美元，即便周二(4 日) 單日回補 5704 萬美元，也未扭轉撤離態勢，3 倍做多韓股 ETF(KORU)同期亦遭淨賣超 4563 萬美元。
市場解讀，SOXL 價格 7 月初衝上 200 美元後一度跌破 100 美元、近期反彈，散戶趁拉升獲利了結。
資金並未離開半導體賽道，而是從槓桿 ETF 轉向實體個股。本周前兩個交易日，美光淨買超 1.4083 億美元居首，閃迪 1.4547 億美元次之，SK 海力士 ADR 流入 9323 萬美元 (約 1330 億韓元) 排第三。
南韓散戶布局美股大方向未斷，6 月淨買 6.33 億、7 月暴增至 46.69 億美元，8 月開局續淨買 2.78 億美元，連三月淨流入。
分析師指出，槓桿 ETF 適合短線博弈、波動侵蝕收益，在 HBM 與 AI 記憶體景氣向上階段，資金更願直接持有業績兌現能力強的個股。
韓股此輪「去槓桿」反映散戶在半導體高β行情中，由追漲槓桿轉向挑選標的的精選操作。
paras_en: According to data from South Korea's Securities Depository Center SEIBRO, South Korean investors in US stocks sold a net $6.6439 billion worth of 3x Leveraged ETF (SOXL) on Monday, which is equivalent to 17.5% of the net buying of $37.8586 billion in July. Despite a net sale of $6.0735 billion over the first two days of the week, the trend of selling continued, with a net sale of $4563 million in the 3x Leveraged ETF (KORU) over the same period.
Market analysts believe that the price of SOXL rose to $200 in early July, only to drop below $100, and has since rebounded, prompting retail investors to take profits.

The funds did not leave the semiconductor sector, but instead shifted from leveraged ETFs to individual stocks. Over the first two trading days of the week, Micron Technology saw a net inflow of $1.4083 billion, followed by Western Digital with $1.4547 billion, and SK Hynix ADR with $9323 million (approximately 1.33 trillion won).

South Korean retail investors have not given up on their US stock strategy, with net buying of $6.33 billion in June, $46.69 billion in July, and $2.78 billion in August, marking three consecutive months of net inflows.

Analysts point out that leveraged ETFs are suitable for short-term trading and can erode profits due to volatility. As the HBM and AI memory market enters an upward phase, investors prefer to hold individual stocks with strong performance capabilities.
The 'de-leveraging' trend in South Korea reflects the shift of retail investors from chasing leveraged ETFs to selecting individual stocks in the high-beta semiconductor market.

items.title: 全球記憶體荒恐比預期更久！2027年產能已售罄 供應吃緊一路延至2028年
items.title_en: Global Memory Shortage May Last Longer Than Expected, 2027 Production Already Sold Out
paras: 全球記憶體供應危機持續升溫，AI 浪潮帶動資料中心大舉擴建，不僅推升高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 需求，也排擠傳統 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 產能，使整體市場供需失衡情況進一步惡化。
根據外媒引述產業消息指出，三星電子、SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 與美光 (Micron) 等主要記憶體供應商，已提前售罄 2027 年 DRAM 與 HBM 產能，市場普遍預期，供應緊張局面至少將持續至 2028 年。
報導指出，目前 AI 基礎建設投資仍快速增加，大型雲端服務供應商 (Hyperscaler) 及 AI 企業為確保未來供貨，已提前與記憶體廠簽訂長期供貨合約，甚至接受預付款模式鎖定產能。由於主要供應商將有限產能優先分配給大型客戶，中小型企業及消費性電子品牌未來取得記憶體的難度也將同步提高。
除了 DRAM 外，NAND Flash 市場供應同樣趨於緊俏。市場消息指出，今年主要 NAND 供應商的產能也陸續被預訂，其中三星、美光及 SanDisk 的年度產能已幾乎售罄，鎧俠 (Kioxia) 及 SK 海力士也預計在近期完成 2027 年供貨合約，使整體記憶體市場持續維持供不應求。
AI 需求排擠傳統市場 HBM 成為兵家必爭之地
這波記憶體供應危機，核心原因並非消費性電子需求突然大幅成長，而是 AI 資料中心對高效能記憶體的需求持續攀升。
相較於一般 DRAM，HBM 採用多層晶片堆疊與矽穿孔 (TSV) 封裝技術，可提供遠高於傳統 DRAM 的資料傳輸頻寬，是 AI GPU 及 AI 加速器不可或缺的核心元件。由於 HBM 單位售價與獲利能力遠高於一般 DRAM，記憶體廠也持續將更多產能投入 HBM 產品，進一步壓縮 PC、智慧手機及其他消費性電子產品可使用的 DRAM 供應。
市場人士指出，目前 AI 基礎建設建置速度仍遠快於新增產能速度，幾乎所有新增產能都被大型雲端業者優先吸收，也使一般市場持續面臨供應不足與價格上漲壓力。
新產能難快速到位 供需失衡短期難解
業界認為，供應緊張不易在短時間內改善，主因在於新晶圓廠建置需要相當長時間。
從興建新廠、設備進駐到正式量產，通常需要數年時間，若在美國設廠，因法規與建廠流程更為複雜，所需時間可能更長。雖然三星、美光及 SK 海力士目前都已啟動擴產計畫，但新增產能短期內仍不足以追上 AI 帶來的需求增速，因此市場普遍認為，至少未來兩年記憶體供需仍將維持緊繃。
此外，由於大型 AI 企業願意支付更高價格取得供貨，供應商自然也更傾向將有限產能優先分配至高毛利產品，使傳統消費性市場持續承受供貨不足壓力。
三大記憶體廠一致示警 2027 年恐成最吃緊一年
主要供應商近期對市場前景也抱持相當保守態度。
美光執行長 Sanjay Mehrotra 表示，即使公司持續擴充全球產能，目前仍無法預見供給何時能追上需求，AI 帶來的需求仍持續快速增加，供需缺口短期內難以消除。
三星電子則認為，2028 年前市場新增供給恐怕都難有明顯改善，今年尚未滿足的需求還可能延續至明年，使供應持續維持緊張狀態。
SK 海力士執行長郭魯正 (Kwak Noh-jung) 更直言，2027 年可能成為整個記憶體產業供應最緊張的一年，且即使放眼 2030 年之後，市場需求仍可能持續高於供給能力。
消費電子成本持續增加 iPhone、PC 都面臨壓力
隨著 AI 企業持續優先取得記憶體資源，智慧手機、PC 等消費性產品可取得的 DRAM 配額也可能逐年縮減。
市場預期，2027 年智慧手機與 PC 製造商採購記憶體的成本將進一步提高，終端產品價格也將面臨更大壓力。雖然大型品牌通常可透過長期採購合約降低部分衝擊，但仍難完全避開整體市場價格上漲趨勢。
蘋果同樣受到影響。雖然公司與供應商簽有長期合作協議，可在一定程度上減緩成本波動，但隨著整體記憶體價格持續攀升，市場普遍預期，今年秋季推出的新款 iPhone 仍可能因零組件成本增加而調整售價，未來若供應持續吃緊，價格壓力也可能延續至 2027 年。
蘋果評估更多供應來源 仍面臨政策限制
為降低供應風險，市場也傳出蘋果正評估更多記憶體採購來源，包括中國記憶體廠長鑫存儲 (CXMT)。
不過，CXMT 目前遭美國政府列入限制名單，美方認為其具有國安疑慮。若蘋果採用相關產品，可能影響未來美國政府採購資格，因此即使 CXMT 具備一定供應能力，蘋果仍須在供應鏈穩定與政策風險之間取得平衡。
科技股週三走勢分歧，美光 (MU-US) 小漲 0.06%，收 893.19 美元，但 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 重挫 5.40%，收每股 1,350.50 美元，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下滑超 2% 至每股 151.03 美元。
paras_en: The global memory supply crisis continues to escalate, driven by the AI wave and the rapid expansion of data centers. This not only drives up demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) but also squeezes out traditional DRAM and NAND Flash production, further exacerbating the market's supply-demand imbalance.

According to industry sources, major memory suppliers such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron have already sold out their 2027 DRAM and HBM production capacity, with the market expecting the supply tightness to continue at least until 2028.

Reports indicate that AI infrastructure investment is still increasing rapidly, with large cloud service providers (hyperscalers) and AI companies signing long-term supply agreements with memory manufacturers, even accepting prepayment models to secure production capacity. As major suppliers prioritize limited production capacity for large customers, small and medium-sized enterprises and consumer electronics brands will face increasing difficulties in obtaining memory in the future.

In addition to DRAM, the NAND Flash market is also experiencing tight supply. Industry sources indicate that major NAND suppliers' production capacity has been largely pre-booked, with Samsung, Micron, and SanDisk's annual production capacity almost sold out, while Kioxia and SK Hynix are expected to complete their 2027 supply contracts in the near future, maintaining the overall memory market's supply-demand imbalance.
AI demand has made HBM a battleground for traditional market players.
This memory supply crisis is not caused by a sudden surge in consumer electronics demand, but rather by the continuous increase in AI data center demand for high-performance memory.

Compared to general DRAM, HBM uses multi-layer chip stacking and silicon through-via (TSV) packaging technology to provide significantly higher data transmission bandwidth, making it an essential component for AI GPUs and AI accelerators. Due to HBM's higher unit price and profitability than general DRAM, memory manufacturers have continued to invest more production capacity in HBM products, further compressing PC, smartphone, and other consumer electronics products' DRAM supply.

Industry insiders point out that the current AI infrastructure construction speed is still far ahead of the addition of new production capacity, with almost all new production capacity being absorbed by large cloud service providers, leaving the general market to face ongoing supply shortages and price increases.
New production capacity is difficult to quickly come online, and the supply-demand imbalance is unlikely to be resolved in the short term.
Industry insiders believe that supply tightness is unlikely to improve in the short term, mainly due to the long time required to build new fabs and bring equipment online.

From building new factories to equipment installation and mass production, it typically takes several years. If a factory is built in the US, the process is even more complex, and the time required may be longer. Although Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix have already launched expansion plans, new production capacity is unlikely to catch up with the demand growth rate in the short term, and the market generally expects that the memory supply-demand situation will remain tight for at least the next two years.

In addition, since large AI companies are willing to pay higher prices to secure supply, suppliers naturally prioritize allocating limited production capacity to high-margin products, leaving traditional consumer markets to continue facing supply shortages.
The three major memory manufacturers have all issued warnings that 2027 may be the most challenging year.
Major suppliers have recently taken a conservative stance on market prospects.

Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated that even with ongoing global capacity expansion, the company cannot yet foresee when supply will catch up with demand, as AI-driven demand continues to grow rapidly, making it difficult to eliminate the supply-demand gap in the short term.

Samsung Electronics believes that it will be difficult to see significant improvements in market supply before 2028, and that this year's unsatisfied demand may continue into next year, maintaining the supply tightness.

SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung went further, stating that 2027 may be the most challenging year for the entire memory industry in terms of supply, and that even looking ahead to 2030, market demand may continue to exceed supply capacity.
Consumer electronics costs continue to rise, putting pressure on iPhone and PC prices.
As AI companies continue to prioritize memory resources, smartphone and PC manufacturers may face shrinking DRAM allocations year by year.

The market expects that the cost of purchasing memory for smartphones and PCs will continue to rise in 2027, and that end-product prices will face greater pressure. Although large brands can use long-term procurement agreements to mitigate some of the impact, they will still find it difficult to avoid the overall market trend of rising prices.

Apple is also affected. Although the company has long-term cooperation agreements with suppliers, which can help mitigate cost fluctuations to some extent, as the overall memory price continues to rise, the market generally expects that the new iPhone models to be released in the fall will still face price adjustments due to increased component costs, and that price pressure may continue into 2027.
Apple evaluates more memory supply sources, still faces policy restrictions.
To reduce supply risks, the market has heard that Apple is evaluating more memory procurement sources, including Chinese memory manufacturer CXMT.

However, CXMT is currently listed on the US government's restricted list, with the US government citing national security concerns. If Apple adopts related products, it may affect its future procurement eligibility, so even if CXMT has some supply capacity, Apple must balance supply chain stability and policy risks.
Tech stocks diverged on Wednesday, with Micron (MU-US) rising 0.06% to $893.19, while SanDisk (SNDK-US) plummeted 5.40% to $1,350.50, and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell over 2% to $151.03.

items.title: 元樟生技 SeepPlug™ 精準孔徑技術跨足中草藥領域 助力台灣中藥材在地種植品質升級
paras: 興櫃生技公司元樟生物科技（TPEx：6864）今年正式將旗下核心平台技術 SeepPlug™ 精準 孔徑栽培介質，導入中草藥種苗與田間栽培應用領域。台灣科學中藥領導品牌順天堂藥廠總經 理莊武璋已於 7 月 20 日親自參訪元樟生技合作農場，就中藥材在地種植的技術痛點與雙方可 能的技術協作展開交流，為兩家分屬生物材料與漢方製藥領域的公司開啟對話。
中藥材在地化的四道關卡：品系溯源、健康種苗、栽培管理與品質規範

台灣中藥材長期面臨供應鏈脆弱的結構性問題。產業普遍認知，約有近九成中藥材仰賴海外進 口，一旦地緣情勢緊張或發生疫情，價格劇烈波動與斷貨風險便隨之而來；2003 年 SARS 期 間金銀花價格飆漲十至二十倍，2020-2023 年 Covid-19 期間多項藥材上漲 5~10 倍，並延續 至 2025 年，為中醫藥經營帶來沉重壓力。與此同時，進口藥材在來源透明度、重金屬與農藥 殘留、品系真偽、微生物污染等面向難以完全掌握，成為中藥現代化與國際外銷的隱形門檻。
在地種植被視為解方，但難度遠高於一般作物栽培。誠如順天堂歷經逾十年才成功以仿生栽培 穩定培育出具活性成分的流蘇石斛，藥用植物一旦產地與生長條件改變，可能導致有效成分流 失、藥材失去功效。中藥材在地化真正的挑戰，主要涵蓋四個環節：品系來源是否正確合法且 可追溯、健康種苗能否穩定量產、田間栽培至採收的品質能否一致管理，以及加工或炮製後的 有效成分與品質能否符合國內外相關規範。
SeepPlug™ 的技術對位：從介質升級為品質管理工具

元樟生技 SeepPlug™ 的核心價值，正是將這前三個環節從「經驗依賴」轉化為「工程可控」。 SeepPlug™ 為工程化栽培介質，原料來源可追溯、規格標準化，並可依不同應用需求進行潔 淨化或滅菌處理，有助降低介質端的污染風險，並支持中藥材對來源透明、重金屬、農藥殘留 及微生物等項目的品質管理要求。其 PoroVance™ 孔隙技術與可調控電解質特性，能為不同 藥用作物客製化根區的水氣與養分環境，滿足石斛、薑科等高敏感作物對 pH 與 EC 的精準需 求，協助健康種苗穩定成型。介質的規格化與可拋棄特性，亦同步降低連作障礙與立枯病等土 傳病害風險，讓田間栽培到採收的品質波動大幅收斂。
元樟生技現階段鎖定的中藥材應用標的，包含台灣流蘇石斛、白及與薑科作物三類。這三類作 物分別代表瀕危管制藥材的人工栽培溯源需求、高經濟價值藥材的種苗量產需求，以及大宗常 用藥材的田間品質一致性需求，構成 SeepPlug™ 中草藥應用的技術驗證主軸。
從栽培介質到生技平台：SeepPlug™拓展中藥材應用版圖

對元樟生技而言，跨入中草藥領域的意義在於重新定義 SeepPlug™ 的技術定位。SeepPlug™ 源自醫療級傷口敷料的 PoroVance™ 精準孔徑工程平台，其價值不僅止於作為栽培基材，更 是一項能協助中藥廠進行品系管理、健康種苗培育及田間栽培標準化的源頭品質管理工具，並 為後續採收、加工及品質評估提供更一致的藥材基礎。當中藥材品質能從源頭被工程化地掌握， 台灣中藥產業長期受制於海外進口、來源難掌握、重金屬與農藥殘留等結構性難題，便有了系 統性突破的技術基礎。
適逢順天堂藥廠創立 80 週年，其長年推動中藥材在地種植、以科學實證強化漢方現代化的努 力，為台灣中藥產業樹立標竿。元樟生技期望以 SeepPlug™ 的精準孔徑技術，成為支持中藥 廠在地化升級的協力力量，共同推動台灣中藥材邁向自主、可控、可溯源的下一階段。

受惠美股 AI 權值股強勢狂飆，集中市場前一交易日三大法人合計大舉買超 1,004.06 億元。其中外資法人單日大舉買超 903.08 億元，創下近期單日買超金額最高紀錄，展現強烈回補台股權值股決心；投信法人買超 86.38 億元，自營商買超 14.57 億元 (自行買賣賣超 23.27 億元、避險買超 37.84 億元）。櫃買市場三大法人於上櫃股票合計賣超 55.16 億元 (外資賣超 29.80 億元，投信賣超 14.68 億元）。大盤展現價增量銳氣勢，短線持續維持強勢震盪上攻態勢。

利基型記憶體 IC 族群 (平均上漲 +8.63%）：受惠國際三大記憶體晶片製造巨頭產能全面轉向 HBM 與高階 DDR5，致使 DDR3/DDR4 與 Flash 現貨與合約報價急遽上揚。邊緣 AI 裝置與消費電子備貨旺季啟動，鈺創 (5351）連續 4 個交易日強勢亮燈漲停收 96.5 元、晶豪科 (3006-TW）大漲 8.97% 收 237 元、愛普 *(6531-TW）大漲 6.70% 收 414 元。

他直言，首季財報「火爆」，分析師獲利估值上修速度前所未見，今年日曆年獲利增速共識約 23%，「我本來不夠看多」。
Yardeni 強調，本輪上漲由企業現金流與利潤創高驅動，而非華府政策或投機 FOMO，拜登基建與特朗普放鬆監管雙輪助推，生產率跳升抵銷油價與工資壓力，嬰兒潮退休族 89 兆美元淨資產成股資金源頭。
Yardeni 還預估，AI 淨增就業，標普本十年末有望挑戰 10000 點。
那斯達克 100 指數四個交易日累漲 9.3%，預期 12 個月本益比 22.3 倍，Yardeni 稱對高成長賽道「相對低廉」。
華爾街同聲看多反彈持續，美光、Alphabet 預期本益比仍低於五年均值，資金從槓桿 ETF 撤出轉進個股。
部分策略師提示，漲勢正從美股「7 巨頭」向半導體、記憶體、電力設備擴散，AI 資本開支外溢決定寬基輪動深度。
但 Yardeni 認為，仍須留意估值集中與地緣局勢回馬槍的風險。標普年初以來漲 8%，若消費韌性失效或美債長端利率再飆，8250 將成壓力測試；但 Yardeni 判斷，只要經濟不衰退、獲利上修不斷電，回撤即買點。
paras_en: Yardeni Research President Ed Yardeni told CNBC that he is raising his S&P 500 target for this year from 7,700 points to 8,250 points and lifting his earnings‑per‑share forecast from $310 to $330.

He said the first‑quarter earnings were “explosive,” and analysts are upgrading profit estimates at a speed never seen before, with consensus earnings growth for the calendar year around 23%, “I was not bullish enough originally.”

Yardeni stressed that the current rally is driven by strong corporate cash flow and profit growth, not by Washington policy or speculative FOMO; the Biden infrastructure plan and Trump‑era deregulation are both helping, productivity gains are offsetting oil‑price and wage pressures, and the $89 trillion net assets of retiring baby‑boomers are a source of equity capital.
He also projected that AI‑driven net job creation could push the S&P 500 to challenge the 10,000‑point level by the end of the decade.
The Nasdaq‑100 has risen 9.3% over four trading days and is expected to trade at a 12‑month forward P/E of 22.3×, which Yardeni says is “relatively cheap” for a high‑growth segment.

Wall Street broadly expects the rebound to continue, with Micron and Alphabet still trading at P/E ratios below their five‑year averages, and money flowing out of leveraged ETFs into individual stocks.

Some strategists note that the rally is spreading from the U.S. “big‑seven” stocks to semiconductors, memory chips and power‑equipment firms, as AI‑related capital spending spill‑over determines the depth of the broad market rotation.

Yardeni cautions that valuation concentration and geopolitical flash‑points remain risks. The S&P has risen about 8% since the start of the year; if consumer resilience fades or long‑term U.S. Treasury yields spike again, the 8,250 target could become a stress test, but Yardeni judges that as long as the economy avoids recession and earnings upgrades keep coming, pullbacks will be buying opportunities.

items.title: 全球記憶體荒恐比預期更久！2027年產能已售罄 供應吃緊一路延至2028年
items.title_en: Global Memory Shortage May Last Longer Than Expected, 2027 Production Already Sold Out
paras: 全球記憶體供應危機持續升溫，AI 浪潮帶動資料中心大舉擴建，不僅推升高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 需求，也排擠傳統 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 產能，使整體市場供需失衡情況進一步惡化。
根據外媒引述產業消息指出，三星電子、SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 與美光 (Micron) 等主要記憶體供應商，已提前售罄 2027 年 DRAM 與 HBM 產能，市場普遍預期，供應緊張局面至少將持續至 2028 年。
報導指出，目前 AI 基礎建設投資仍快速增加，大型雲端服務供應商 (Hyperscaler) 及 AI 企業為確保未來供貨，已提前與記憶體廠簽訂長期供貨合約，甚至接受預付款模式鎖定產能。由於主要供應商將有限產能優先分配給大型客戶，中小型企業及消費性電子品牌未來取得記憶體的難度也將同步提高。
除了 DRAM 外，NAND Flash 市場供應同樣趨於緊俏。市場消息指出，今年主要 NAND 供應商的產能也陸續被預訂，其中三星、美光及 SanDisk 的年度產能已幾乎售罄，鎧俠 (Kioxia) 及 SK 海力士也預計在近期完成 2027 年供貨合約，使整體記憶體市場持續維持供不應求。
AI 需求排擠傳統市場 HBM 成為兵家必爭之地
這波記憶體供應危機，核心原因並非消費性電子需求突然大幅成長，而是 AI 資料中心對高效能記憶體的需求持續攀升。
相較於一般 DRAM，HBM 採用多層晶片堆疊與矽穿孔 (TSV) 封裝技術，可提供遠高於傳統 DRAM 的資料傳輸頻寬，是 AI GPU 及 AI 加速器不可或缺的核心元件。由於 HBM 單位售價與獲利能力遠高於一般 DRAM，記憶體廠也持續將更多產能投入 HBM 產品，進一步壓縮 PC、智慧手機及其他消費性電子產品可使用的 DRAM 供應。
市場人士指出，目前 AI 基礎建設建置速度仍遠快於新增產能速度，幾乎所有新增產能都被大型雲端業者優先吸收，也使一般市場持續面臨供應不足與價格上漲壓力。
新產能難快速到位 供需失衡短期難解
業界認為，供應緊張不易在短時間內改善，主因在於新晶圓廠建置需要相當長時間。
從興建新廠、設備進駐到正式量產，通常需要數年時間，若在美國設廠，因法規與建廠流程更為複雜，所需時間可能更長。雖然三星、美光及 SK 海力士目前都已啟動擴產計畫，但新增產能短期內仍不足以追上 AI 帶來的需求增速，因此市場普遍認為，至少未來兩年記憶體供需仍將維持緊繃。
此外，由於大型 AI 企業願意支付更高價格取得供貨，供應商自然也更傾向將有限產能優先分配至高毛利產品，使傳統消費性市場持續承受供貨不足壓力。
三大記憶體廠一致示警 2027 年恐成最吃緊一年
主要供應商近期對市場前景也抱持相當保守態度。
美光執行長 Sanjay Mehrotra 表示，即使公司持續擴充全球產能，目前仍無法預見供給何時能追上需求，AI 帶來的需求仍持續快速增加，供需缺口短期內難以消除。
三星電子則認為，2028 年前市場新增供給恐怕都難有明顯改善，今年尚未滿足的需求還可能延續至明年，使供應持續維持緊張狀態。
SK 海力士執行長郭魯正 (Kwak Noh-jung) 更直言，2027 年可能成為整個記憶體產業供應最緊張的一年，且即使放眼 2030 年之後，市場需求仍可能持續高於供給能力。
消費電子成本持續增加 iPhone、PC 都面臨壓力
隨著 AI 企業持續優先取得記憶體資源，智慧手機、PC 等消費性產品可取得的 DRAM 配額也可能逐年縮減。
市場預期，2027 年智慧手機與 PC 製造商採購記憶體的成本將進一步提高，終端產品價格也將面臨更大壓力。雖然大型品牌通常可透過長期採購合約降低部分衝擊，但仍難完全避開整體市場價格上漲趨勢。
蘋果同樣受到影響。雖然公司與供應商簽有長期合作協議，可在一定程度上減緩成本波動，但隨著整體記憶體價格持續攀升，市場普遍預期，今年秋季推出的新款 iPhone 仍可能因零組件成本增加而調整售價，未來若供應持續吃緊，價格壓力也可能延續至 2027 年。
蘋果評估更多供應來源 仍面臨政策限制
為降低供應風險，市場也傳出蘋果正評估更多記憶體採購來源，包括中國記憶體廠長鑫存儲 (CXMT)。
不過，CXMT 目前遭美國政府列入限制名單，美方認為其具有國安疑慮。若蘋果採用相關產品，可能影響未來美國政府採購資格，因此即使 CXMT 具備一定供應能力，蘋果仍須在供應鏈穩定與政策風險之間取得平衡。
科技股週三走勢分歧，美光 (MU-US) 小漲 0.06%，收 893.19 美元，但 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 重挫 5.40%，收每股 1,350.50 美元，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下滑超 2% 至每股 151.03 美元。
paras_en: The global memory supply crisis continues to escalate, driven by the AI wave and the rapid expansion of data centers. This not only drives up demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) but also squeezes out traditional DRAM and NAND Flash production, further exacerbating the market's supply-demand imbalance.

According to industry sources, major memory suppliers such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron have already sold out their 2027 DRAM and HBM production capacity, with the market expecting the supply tightness to continue at least until 2028.

Reports indicate that AI infrastructure investment is still increasing rapidly, with large cloud service providers (hyperscalers) and AI companies signing long-term supply agreements with memory manufacturers, even accepting prepayment models to secure production capacity. As major suppliers prioritize limited production capacity for large customers, small and medium-sized enterprises and consumer electronics brands will face increasing difficulties in obtaining memory in the future.

In addition to DRAM, the NAND Flash market is also experiencing tight supply. Industry sources indicate that major NAND suppliers' production capacity has been largely pre-booked, with Samsung, Micron, and SanDisk's annual production capacity almost sold out, while Kioxia and SK Hynix are expected to complete their 2027 supply contracts in the near future, maintaining the overall memory market's supply-demand imbalance.
AI demand has made HBM a battleground for traditional market players.
This memory supply crisis is not caused by a sudden surge in consumer electronics demand, but rather by the continuous increase in AI data center demand for high-performance memory.

Compared to general DRAM, HBM uses multi-layer chip stacking and silicon through-via (TSV) packaging technology to provide significantly higher data transmission bandwidth, making it an essential component for AI GPUs and AI accelerators. Due to HBM's higher unit price and profitability than general DRAM, memory manufacturers have continued to invest more production capacity in HBM products, further compressing PC, smartphone, and other consumer electronics products' DRAM supply.

Industry insiders point out that the current AI infrastructure construction speed is still far ahead of the addition of new production capacity, with almost all new production capacity being absorbed by large cloud service providers, leaving the general market to face ongoing supply shortages and price increases.
New production capacity is difficult to quickly come online, and the supply-demand imbalance is unlikely to be resolved in the short term.
Industry insiders believe that supply tightness is unlikely to improve in the short term, mainly due to the long time required to build new fabs and bring equipment online.

From building new factories to equipment installation and mass production, it typically takes several years. If a factory is built in the US, the process is even more complex, and the time required may be longer. Although Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix have already launched expansion plans, new production capacity is unlikely to catch up with the demand growth rate in the short term, and the market generally expects that the memory supply-demand situation will remain tight for at least the next two years.

In addition, since large AI companies are willing to pay higher prices to secure supply, suppliers naturally prioritize allocating limited production capacity to high-margin products, leaving traditional consumer markets to continue facing supply shortages.
The three major memory manufacturers have all issued warnings that 2027 may be the most challenging year.
Major suppliers have recently taken a conservative stance on market prospects.

Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated that even with ongoing global capacity expansion, the company cannot yet foresee when supply will catch up with demand, as AI-driven demand continues to grow rapidly, making it difficult to eliminate the supply-demand gap in the short term.

Samsung Electronics believes that it will be difficult to see significant improvements in market supply before 2028, and that this year's unsatisfied demand may continue into next year, maintaining the supply tightness.

SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung went further, stating that 2027 may be the most challenging year for the entire memory industry in terms of supply, and that even looking ahead to 2030, market demand may continue to exceed supply capacity.
Consumer electronics costs continue to rise, putting pressure on iPhone and PC prices.
As AI companies continue to prioritize memory resources, smartphone and PC manufacturers may face shrinking DRAM allocations year by year.

The market expects that the cost of purchasing memory for smartphones and PCs will continue to rise in 2027, and that end-product prices will face greater pressure. Although large brands can use long-term procurement agreements to mitigate some of the impact, they will still find it difficult to avoid the overall market trend of rising prices.

Apple is also affected. Although the company has long-term cooperation agreements with suppliers, which can help mitigate cost fluctuations to some extent, as the overall memory price continues to rise, the market generally expects that the new iPhone models to be released in the fall will still face price adjustments due to increased component costs, and that price pressure may continue into 2027.
Apple evaluates more memory supply sources, still faces policy restrictions.
To reduce supply risks, the market has heard that Apple is evaluating more memory procurement sources, including Chinese memory manufacturer CXMT.

However, CXMT is currently listed on the US government's restricted list, with the US government citing national security concerns. If Apple adopts related products, it may affect its future procurement eligibility, so even if CXMT has some supply capacity, Apple must balance supply chain stability and policy risks.
Tech stocks diverged on Wednesday, with Micron (MU-US) rising 0.06% to $893.19, while SanDisk (SNDK-US) plummeted 5.40% to $1,350.50, and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell over 2% to $151.03.

Sandisk 第 4 季資料中心業務營收 29.8 億美元，高於市場預估的 27.4 億美元，與第 3 季相比增加超過一倍。
執行長 David Goeckeler 表示，Sandisk 以領先的技術產品組合完成 2026 會計年度，並將資料中心打造為核心成長動能，同時進一步深化與客戶的合作關係。
Sandisk 表示，自 4 月以來，在新的商業模式下已另外簽署五項協議，其中包括三家新客戶，以及兩項既有客戶的合作擴大案。
Sandisk 董事會也批准新增 140 億美元庫藏股計畫，使該公司剩餘可執行的股票回購額度提高至 155 億美元。

items.title: IonQ揭量子運算財報季序幕 營收暴增近4倍、上修全年財測
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，IonQ(QBTS-US)周三 (5 日) 率先揭開量子運算公司財報季序幕，執行長形容，這是公司「史上最強一季」。
總部位於美國馬里蘭州的 IonQ，近年已從量子運算拓展至量子網路與量子感測等相關技術領域。
公司 2026 會計年度第二季調整後每股虧損為 0.33 美元，優於分析師預估的虧損 0.56 美元。
真正亮點來自營收。第二季營收達 8,010 萬美元，較去年同期暴增近 4 倍，高於華爾街預估的 6,650 萬美元。管理層表示，營收大幅成長主要受惠於商業客戶對 Tempo 量子電腦需求增加，以及雲端運算服務需求持續強勁。
儘管營收大幅成長，IonQ 本季淨虧損仍擴大至約 19 億美元。公司調整後 EBITDA(稅息折舊及攤銷前) 虧損為 1.203 億美元，主要反映與 SkyWater Technologies(SKYT-US) 商業合作，以及收購交易相關成本。去年同期淨虧損與調整後 EBITDA 虧損分別為 1.775 億美元及 3,650 萬美元。
市場對此並不感到意外：IonQ 目前仍未獲利，儘管其技術持續獲得企業與政府客戶青睞。對目前的量子運算產業而言，獲利能力並非投資人最關心的指標，他們正等待本世代末有望成為市場催化劑的關鍵技術里程碑。
財報公布後，IonQ 盤後股價一度上漲約 2%。該股周三收盤下跌 2%。
市場反應偏正面，部分原因在於公司上調全年財測。IonQ 目前預估，2026 年全年營收將介於 2.8 億至 2.9 億美元，高於先前預估的 2.6 億至 2.7 億美元。分析師平均預估全年營收約 2.686 億美元。
為了在量子運算商業化前進一步提升競爭力，IonQ 近年積極透過併購擴大布局。上周完成對晶片製造商 SkyWater Technologies 價值 18 億美元的收購案。藉此將 SkyWater 旗下半導體晶圓代工能力納入，進一步掌握量子硬體供應鏈。
這項交易也正值美國政府進一步強化國內量子供應鏈之際。今年 5 月，包括 Rigetti Computing(RGTI-US) 及 D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 等多家上市公司，已與美國商務部達成初步協議，以釋出部分股權換取聯邦政府資金支持。
雖然 IonQ 並未參與這項協議，但仍是美國政府的重要合作夥伴。執行長 Niccolo de Masi 於去年 7 月出席白宮量子創新峰會，進一步展現公司與美國聯邦政府之間的緊密合作關係。IonQ 去年底已成立專門服務政府客戶的事業部門。

items.title: 美禁中國光模組恐傷AI競爭力！研究：西方產能兩年內難補缺口
items.title_en: U.S. Ban on Chinese Optical Modules Could Hurt AI Competitiveness, Study Says Western Capacity Won't Fill Gap Within Two Years
paras: 美國擬限制中國光收發模組 (Optical Transceiver) 進口，引發市場看好美國供應商可望受惠，但最新研究指出，若禁令倉促上路，反而可能衝擊美國 AI 基礎建設發展。
根據外媒週三 (5 日) 報導，Counterpoint Research 警告，中國廠商目前掌握全球約六成至三分之二的光收發模組供應能力，西方廠商至少未來一至兩年內仍無法完全填補產能缺口。
Counterpoint 分析師 Neil Shah 表示，美國若迅速實施禁令，可能導致光模組供應不足，進一步推高建置成本、延後 AI 資料中心部署時程，甚至降低昂貴 AI 加速器 (Accelerator) 的使用效率，影響大型科技公司數千億美元的資本支出規畫。
Shah 指出，AWS、微軟 (MSFT-US)、Meta (META-US) 及 Alphabet (GOOG-US) 等超大規模雲端業者，未來都可能面臨 AI 叢集 (AI Cluster) 建設延誤的風險。他表示，若監管政策突然改變，恐造成硬體供應瓶頸，拖慢全球大型雲端服務商的 AI 部署進度。
此前，《路透》週二報導，美國總統川普政府正研擬禁止進口新的中國資料中心光收發模組，並希望聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 能在今年底前公布相關規範。不過，該措施目前仍在討論階段，內容仍可能修改，甚至取消。
光收發模組是 AI 資料中心的重要元件，負責將電子訊號轉換為光訊號，在光纖中高速傳輸資料。隨著 AI 超級叢集對 400G、800G 及 1.6T 高速互連需求快速提升，其重要性也持續增加。
Raymond James 指出，若禁令正式實施，美股上市公司 Coherent (COHR-US) 及 Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 將是最直接受惠者，有望承接原本流向中國供應商的訂單。
不過，Counterpoint 認為，美國供應商短時間內仍難以完全接手。Shah 表示，Coherent 及 Lumentum 目前仍缺乏足夠的無塵室產能、自動化封裝能力及量產良率，至少未來 12 至 24 個月內，難以承接中際旭創 (Innolight) 及新易盛 (Eoptolink) 的龐大出貨規模。
受路透報導影響，中國光通訊族群周三全面走弱。海外營收占比高達 96% 的新易盛深圳股價一度重挫 10%；中際旭創 A 股及港股同步下跌約 8%；天孚通信 (Suzhou TFC Optical Communications) 跌約 6%，滬深 300 電信服務指數盤中一度下跌 9%。
相較之下，美國光通訊族群前一交易日大漲。Coherent 收漲 11%、Applied Optoelectronics 勁揚 18%、Lumentum 上漲 7%，市場預期若禁令落實，西方供應商將有機會獲得更多訂單。
Counterpoint 統計，中際旭創目前約占全球資料中心光收發模組營收 27%，2026 年第一季有 62% 營收來自美國市場；整體中國廠商則掌握約 60% 的全球資料中心光收發模組營收。
雖然中際旭創與新易盛近年均已將部分產能移往泰國，以降低美中貿易政策帶來的風險，但目前仍不清楚泰國生產的產品是否能豁免於未來禁令之外。
Shah 強調，將全球光收發模組市場簡單切割為「中國」與「非中國」兩個體系，並不符合產業實際運作模式。他指出，目前全球 AI 產業仍高度依賴中國光模組廠商的大規模製造能力。
此外，整體供應鏈本身也高度全球化。中國光模組廠商仍須採用博通 (AVGO-US)、Marvell (MRVL-US) 的數位訊號處理器 (DSP)，以及 Lumentum、Coherent 與三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 的雷射元件，因此任何禁令都可能擾亂整條高度整合的全球供應鏈，而非單純將市場一分為二。
值得注意的是，中際旭創甫於 7 月 30 日在香港完成約 68 億美元上市，為今年香港最大規模 IPO；該公司也於今年 6 月被美國國防部列入涉嫌與中國軍方有關聯企業名單。
目前 Applied Optoelectronics 是少數具備美國本土生產能力的主要供應商，並持續擴充產能。Raymond James 也認為，若 Coherent 未來決定投入相關投資，也具備在美國建立光收發模組產線的潛力。
paras_en: The United States is planning to restrict imports of Chinese optical transceiver modules, prompting market optimism that U.S. suppliers could benefit. However, a new study warns that a rushed ban could actually damage the development of U.S. AI infrastructure.

According to foreign media reports on Wednesday (the 5th), Counterpoint Research cautioned that Chinese manufacturers currently control roughly 60% to two‑thirds of global optical transceiver supply, and Western firms will be unable to fully close the capacity gap for at least one to two years.

Counterpoint analyst Neil Shah said that if the U.S. implements the ban quickly, it could create a shortage of optical modules, driving up build‑out costs, delaying AI data‑center deployments, and even reducing the efficiency of expensive AI accelerators—affecting the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar capital‑expenditure plans of large tech companies.

Shah noted that mega‑scale cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Alphabet (GOOG-US) could all face delays in constructing AI clusters. He warned that a sudden regulatory shift could create hardware supply bottlenecks and slow the AI rollout of the world’s biggest cloud operators.

Earlier, Reuters reported on Tuesday that the Trump administration was drafting a ban on new Chinese data‑center optical transceivers and hoped the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) would issue related rules by the end of the year. The measure is still under discussion and could be revised or dropped.

Optical transceiver modules are critical components of AI data centers, converting electrical signals to optical signals for high‑speed fiber transmission. As AI super‑clusters increase demand for 400G, 800G and 1.6T interconnects, their importance continues to grow.

Raymond James said that if the ban is enacted, U.S. listed companies Coherent (COHR-US) and Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) would be the most direct beneficiaries, likely capturing orders that would otherwise go to Chinese suppliers.

Counterpoint, however, believes U.S. suppliers cannot take over the market in the short term. Shah explained that Coherent and Lumentum still lack sufficient clean‑room capacity, automated packaging capability and mass‑production yields, making it unlikely they can absorb the large shipment volumes of Innolight and Eoptolink for the next 12‑24 months.

Following Reuters’ report, Chinese optical‑communication stocks fell across the board on Wednesday. Shenzhen‑listed Eoptolink, which derives 96% of its revenue from overseas, saw its share price plunge about 10%; Innolight’s A‑shares and Hong Kong shares dropped roughly 8%; and TFC Optical Communications fell about 6%, while the CSI 300 Telecom Services Index slid as much as 9% intraday.

In contrast, U.S. optical‑communication stocks surged the previous trading day. Coherent rose 11%, Applied Optoelectronics jumped 18%, and Lumentum gained 7%, as the market anticipates that a ban would channel more orders to Western suppliers.

Counterpoint estimates that Innolight currently accounts for about 27% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue and that 62% of its Q1‑2026 revenue will come from the U.S.; overall, Chinese firms hold roughly 60% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue.

Although Innolight and Eoptolink have shifted part of their production to Thailand in recent years to mitigate U.S.–China trade risks, it remains unclear whether Thai‑made products would be exempt from a future ban.

Shah emphasized that simply dividing the global optical transceiver market into “China” and “non‑China” segments does not reflect industry reality. He pointed out that the worldwide AI sector still heavily relies on the large‑scale manufacturing capacity of Chinese optical‑module makers.

Moreover, the supply chain is highly globalized. Chinese optical‑module firms still use Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Marvell (MRVL-US) digital signal processors, as well as lasers from Lumentum, Coherent and Mitsubishi Electric, meaning any ban could disrupt an integrated global supply chain rather than just split the market.

It is worth noting that Innolight completed a roughly $6.8 billion IPO in Hong Kong on July 30, the largest Hong Kong listing this year, and was added to a U.S. Department of Defense list in June of companies suspected of ties to the Chinese military.

Applied Optoelectronics is currently one of the few major suppliers with U.S. domestic production capability and is expanding capacity. Raymond James also believes that if Coherent decides to invest in the area, it has the potential to build an optical transceiver production line in the United States.

items.title: 馬斯克點名SpaceX全面導入輝達AI晶片 AMD慘崩超7%、輝達喜揚超3%
items.title_en: Musk Names AMD's Collapse and NVIDIA's Surge in AI Chip Market
paras: SpaceX 上市後首場財報法說會意外成為 AI 晶片市場焦點。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布，未來 SpaceX 的 AI 基礎設施將全面採用輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，消息激勵輝達股價週三 (6 日) 收盤喜升逾 3%，AMD 則慘崩逾 7%。
馬斯克在法說會上表示，SpaceX 經過評估後，認為輝達的 Vera Rubin 架構是目前最優秀的 AI 運算平台，因此公司未來 AI 系統將「完全建立在輝達平台之上」，雙方也將持續深化合作。
他透露，SpaceX 預計今年底 AI 運算能力將突破 2GW，到 2027 年底進一步擴大至接近 10GW。公司也計畫自明年起部署 Starmind 衛星網路，並把輝達 Vera Rubin NVL72 機櫃系統同時應用於地面與太空資料中心。
馬斯克指出，相較於地面資料中心，太空資料中心不需大量土地，且可利用太空環境降低散熱需求，因此具備長期發展潛力。不過，如何將大型 AI 伺服器成功送入軌道並完成部署與連線，仍將面臨不小的技術挑戰。
SpaceX 同時公布最新 AI 業務表現。受惠於雲端服務合作案，以及 Grok 與 X 訂閱業務持續成長，公司 AI 業務營收達 26 億美元，較前一季大增 213%，年增 247%。
此外，SpaceX 已與 Google、Anthropic 簽署總額達數十億美元的資料中心租賃協議，未來將提供 AI 運算容量，支援兩家公司擴大人工智慧服務。
相較之下，AMD 雖繳出優於市場預期的第二季成績單，仍難掩市場失望情緒。
AMD 第二季營收 115.4 億美元、調整後每股盈餘 1.66 美元，均優於市場預估。其中，資料中心營收攀升至歷史新高 67 億美元，占總營收比重提高至 58%，主要受 EPYC 處理器與 Instinct AI GPU 出貨帶動；客戶端與遊戲事業營收則為 38.4 億美元，年增約 6%。
展望後市，AMD 預估第三季營收約 130 億美元 (上下浮動 3 億美元)，高於市場預估的 125.1 億美元，意味著年增約 41%、季增約 13%。
執行長蘇姿丰表示，公司下半年營運動能持續增強，EPYC 需求加速成長、Instinct 部署持續擴大，Helios 平台也將開始放量，AI 正推動各項運算需求快速提升。
她指出，AMD 近期已取得多項大型 AI 基礎設施合作案，包括 Anthropic、Meta 及 Core Scientific 等客戶，並將 2030 年 CPU 市場規模預估上修至超過 2,000 億美元，目標拿下逾 50% 市占率，同時預估明年伺服器業務營收將成長超過 70%。
部分華爾街分析師認為，儘管 AMD 展望依舊強勁，但市場原本期待公司在 AI 晶片業務能出現更快速的成長，因此財測未完全滿足投資人對短期爆發力的期待；再加上馬斯克宣布 SpaceX 將 AI 基礎設施全面轉向輝達，也進一步打擊市場情緒，拖累 AMD 股價大幅回落。
paras_en: SpaceX's first earnings call since going public unexpectedly became the focus of the AI chip market. CEO Elon Musk announced that SpaceX's AI infrastructure will fully adopt NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips in the future, which sparked a surge of over 3% in NVIDIA's stock price on Wednesday (6th), while AMD plummeted over 7%.

Musk stated at the earnings call that after evaluation, SpaceX believes NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture is the most excellent AI computation platform currently, and the company's future AI systems will "completely be built on the NVIDIA platform", with both parties continuing to deepen their cooperation.

He revealed that SpaceX expects its AI computation capacity to break through 2GW by the end of the year and further expand to nearly 10GW by the end of 2027. The company also plans to deploy the Starmind satellite network from next year and apply the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 server system simultaneously to both ground and space data centers.

Musk pointed out that compared to ground data centers, space data centers do not require large amounts of land and can utilize the space environment to reduce heat dissipation requirements, thus having long-term development potential. However, how to successfully send large AI servers into orbit and complete deployment and connection will still face significant technical challenges.

SpaceX also announced its latest AI business performance. Benefiting from cloud service cooperation and the continued growth of Grok and X subscription businesses, the company's AI business revenue reached $2.6 billion, a 213% increase from the previous quarter and a 247% increase from the previous year.

In addition, SpaceX has signed a data center rental agreement with Google and Anthropic worth tens of billions of dollars, which will provide AI computation capacity to support the expansion of the two companies' artificial intelligence services.
In contrast, AMD, despite submitting a better-than-expected second-quarter earnings report, was unable to alleviate market disappointment.

AMD's second-quarter revenue was $11.54 billion, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.66, both of which were better than market estimates. Among them, data center revenue rose to a historical high of $6.7 billion, accounting for 58% of total revenue, mainly driven by the shipment of EPYC processors and Instinct AI GPUs; client and gaming business revenue was $3.84 billion, a 6% increase from the previous year.

Looking ahead, AMD estimates third-quarter revenue of approximately $13 billion (with a 3 billion dollar range), higher than market estimates of $12.51 billion, indicating a 41% increase from the previous year and a 13% increase from the previous quarter.

CEO Lisa Su stated that the company's second-half operating momentum will continue to strengthen, with EPYC demand accelerating growth, Instinct deployment continuing to expand, and the Helios platform starting to ramp up, with AI driving rapid increases in various computation demands.

She pointed out that AMD has recently secured several large-scale AI infrastructure cooperation agreements, including Anthropic, Meta, and Core Scientific, and will upgrade its 2030 CPU market size estimate to over $200 billion, aiming to capture over 50% market share, while also estimating that server business revenue will grow over 70% next year.

Some Wall Street analysts believe that although AMD's outlook remains strong, the market originally expected the company's AI chip business to show faster growth, and the earnings report did not fully meet investors' expectations for short-term explosive power; in addition, Musk's announcement that SpaceX will fully transition its AI infrastructure to NVIDIA has further dampened market sentiment, dragging AMD's stock price down sharply.

items.title: AI熱潮早已見頂？「估值教父」警告：真正危險的不是七巨頭而是「這類」AI股票
items.title_en: Has the AI Boom Already Peaked? Valuation Guru Warns the Real Danger Lies Not in the Magnificent Seven but in These Types of AI Stocks
paras: 紐約大學史登商學院財務金融教授、有「估值教父」之稱的達摩德仁（Aswath Damodaran），近日再度對人工智慧（AI）類股投資人提出警告，指出市場恐怕早已在數月前觸及「AI高峰」，而其中「一部分」的股票未來走勢尤其令人擔憂。
根據《Business Insider》報導，部分AI相關股票近期已出現明顯拋售潮，資金開始轉向其他板塊。
整個7月期間，投資人大舉撤出記憶體與半導體類股。Roundhill DRAM ETF(DRAM-US) 自近期高點以來已下跌36%，而安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 也較近期高點回落22%。
達摩德仁表示：「我認為AI熱潮早在幾個月前就已達到高峰，未來幾個月市場將出現更多整併與修正。」
他並指出，當AI產業迎來洗牌時，真正危險的並非「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven），而是規模較小的AI公司。
達摩德仁解釋稱，基於AI投資主題中的中小型企業缺乏足夠的財務緩衝，一旦AI投資熱潮進一步降溫，將更難承受隨之而來的市場修正，並面臨更大的壓力
近期，隨著投資人重新回補先前遭到拋售的科技股，AI概念股已開始反彈。在市場風險偏好回升帶動下，資金重新流向科技股，道瓊工業指數與標普500指數本週雙雙創下歷史新高。
不過，達摩德仁認為，這波漲勢主要是受到「害怕錯過」（FOMO）情緒驅動，而非企業基本面改善所支撐。
他表示：「投資人心態就是，『現在終於有機會買進AI公司了。』我不會把這件事解讀得更複雜。」
談到投入AI資本支出最多的超大規模雲端服務商時，達摩德仁形容它們是AI產業中「最具防禦力」的一群企業，因為擁有充沛的現金流，也具備承擔大量負債的能力。
儘管如此，他仍對大型AI企業的前景提出警告，指出這些公司正背負愈來愈多債務，但AI資本支出的投資報酬率仍偏低。
達摩德仁指出：「除非它們開始交出與數百億美元資本支出相匹配的獲利表現，否則這些公司未來將演變成截然不同的企業。」
他進一步稱：「這本身沒有問題，但我認為投資人尚未習慣投資一家資本密集度更高的公司所伴隨的風險。」
達摩德仁過去亦曾多次警告，部分AI概念股的估值可能過高。早在2023年，他便指出，輝達(NVDA-US) 的股價從估值角度來看已嚴重偏高，並估計該公司當時的合理價值約僅為市價的一半。
paras_en: New York University Stern School of Business finance professor Aswath Damodaran, known as the “valuation guru,” recently warned AI‑related stock investors that the market may have hit the AI peak months ago, and that a “subset” of those stocks face especially concerning outlooks.
According to Business Insider, some AI‑related stocks have recently experienced a noticeable sell‑off as capital shifts to other sectors.

Throughout July, investors massively withdrew from memory‑chip and semiconductor stocks. The Roundhill DRAM ETF (DRAM‑US) has fallen 36% from its recent high, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) is down 22% from its recent peak.
Damodaran said, “I think the AI hype peaked several months ago, and the market will see more consolidation and correction over the next few months.”
He added that when the AI industry reshuffles, the real danger is not the “Magnificent Seven” U.S. stocks but smaller‑cap AI companies.

Damodaran explained that mid‑ and small‑cap firms in the AI theme lack sufficient financial buffers, so a cooling of the AI hype would make it harder for them to withstand the ensuing market correction and increase pressure on them.

Recently, as investors re‑entered previously sold‑off tech stocks, AI concept stocks have begun to rebound. With renewed risk appetite, capital is flowing back into tech, and both the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 hit all‑time highs this week.
However, Damodaran believes this rally is driven mainly by fear‑of‑missing‑out (FOMO) rather than improvements in company fundamentals.
He said, “The investor mindset is, ‘Now finally there’s a chance to buy AI companies.’ I won’t read anything more complicated into that.”

When discussing the ultra‑large cloud service providers that spend the most on AI capital expenditures, Damodaran described them as the “most defensive” group in the AI industry because they have abundant cash flow and the capacity to take on substantial debt.
Nonetheless, he cautioned that even large AI firms face growing debt loads while the return on AI cap‑ex remains low.
Damodaran noted, “Unless they start delivering earnings that match the hundreds of billions of dollars in cap‑ex, these companies will evolve into very different businesses.”
He added, “That in itself isn’t a problem, but I think investors aren’t yet accustomed to the risks of investing in a more capital‑intensive company.”

Damodaran has repeatedly warned that some AI concept stocks may be overvalued. As early as 2023, he pointed out that Nvidia (NVDA‑US) was severely overvalued from a valuation perspective, estimating its fair value at roughly half of its market price at the time.

items.title: 7700→8250！大幅調高標普年底目標逾一成 華爾街大多頭：美科技股正處於「打折階段」
items.title_en: 7700→8250! S&P Year‑End Target Raised Over 10% as Wall Street Bulls Say Tech Stocks Are in a “Discount Phase”
paras: Yardeni Research 總裁 Ed Yardeni 近日接受《CNBC》訪問時將標普 500 今年目標價從 7700 點上調至 8250 點，並把今年 EPS 預期由 310 美元調升至 330 美元。
他直言，首季財報「火爆」，分析師獲利估值上修速度前所未見，今年日曆年獲利增速共識約 23%，「我本來不夠看多」。
Yardeni 強調，本輪上漲由企業現金流與利潤創高驅動，而非華府政策或投機 FOMO，拜登基建與特朗普放鬆監管雙輪助推，生產率跳升抵銷油價與工資壓力，嬰兒潮退休族 89 兆美元淨資產成股資金源頭。
Yardeni 還預估，AI 淨增就業，標普本十年末有望挑戰 10000 點。
那斯達克 100 指數四個交易日累漲 9.3%，預期 12 個月本益比 22.3 倍，Yardeni 稱對高成長賽道「相對低廉」。
華爾街同聲看多反彈持續，美光、Alphabet 預期本益比仍低於五年均值，資金從槓桿 ETF 撤出轉進個股。
部分策略師提示，漲勢正從美股「7 巨頭」向半導體、記憶體、電力設備擴散，AI 資本開支外溢決定寬基輪動深度。
但 Yardeni 認為，仍須留意估值集中與地緣局勢回馬槍的風險。標普年初以來漲 8%，若消費韌性失效或美債長端利率再飆，8250 將成壓力測試；但 Yardeni 判斷，只要經濟不衰退、獲利上修不斷電，回撤即買點。
paras_en: Yardeni Research President Ed Yardeni told CNBC that he is raising his S&P 500 target for this year from 7,700 points to 8,250 points and lifting his earnings‑per‑share forecast from $310 to $330.

He said the first‑quarter earnings were “explosive,” and analysts are upgrading profit estimates at a speed never seen before, with consensus earnings growth for the calendar year around 23%, “I was not bullish enough originally.”

Yardeni stressed that the current rally is driven by strong corporate cash flow and profit growth, not by Washington policy or speculative FOMO; the Biden infrastructure plan and Trump‑era deregulation are both helping, productivity gains are offsetting oil‑price and wage pressures, and the $89 trillion net assets of retiring baby‑boomers are a source of equity capital.
He also projected that AI‑driven net job creation could push the S&P 500 to challenge the 10,000‑point level by the end of the decade.
The Nasdaq‑100 has risen 9.3% over four trading days and is expected to trade at a 12‑month forward P/E of 22.3×, which Yardeni says is “relatively cheap” for a high‑growth segment.

Wall Street broadly expects the rebound to continue, with Micron and Alphabet still trading at P/E ratios below their five‑year averages, and money flowing out of leveraged ETFs into individual stocks.

Some strategists note that the rally is spreading from the U.S. “big‑seven” stocks to semiconductors, memory chips and power‑equipment firms, as AI‑related capital spending spill‑over determines the depth of the broad market rotation.

Yardeni cautions that valuation concentration and geopolitical flash‑points remain risks. The S&P has risen about 8% since the start of the year; if consumer resilience fades or long‑term U.S. Treasury yields spike again, the 8,250 target could become a stress test, but Yardeni judges that as long as the economy avoids recession and earnings upgrades keep coming, pullbacks will be buying opportunities.

items.title_en: South Korean Retail Investors Flock to Sell US Stock ETFs, Profits Near 10 Trillion Won
paras: 南韓預託結算院 SEIBRO 平台周三 (5 日) 數據顯示，截至周一 (3 日)，南韓的美股投資人單日淨賣超費半指數 3 倍槓桿 ETF(SOXL) 共 6.6439 億美元 (約 9486 億韓元)，規模相當於 7 月全月淨買超 37.8586 億美元的 17.5%，但本周前兩日合計仍淨賣出 6.0735 億美元，即便周二(4 日) 單日回補 5704 萬美元，也未扭轉撤離態勢，3 倍做多韓股 ETF(KORU)同期亦遭淨賣超 4563 萬美元。
市場解讀，SOXL 價格 7 月初衝上 200 美元後一度跌破 100 美元、近期反彈，散戶趁拉升獲利了結。
資金並未離開半導體賽道，而是從槓桿 ETF 轉向實體個股。本周前兩個交易日，美光淨買超 1.4083 億美元居首，閃迪 1.4547 億美元次之，SK 海力士 ADR 流入 9323 萬美元 (約 1330 億韓元) 排第三。
南韓散戶布局美股大方向未斷，6 月淨買 6.33 億、7 月暴增至 46.69 億美元，8 月開局續淨買 2.78 億美元，連三月淨流入。
分析師指出，槓桿 ETF 適合短線博弈、波動侵蝕收益，在 HBM 與 AI 記憶體景氣向上階段，資金更願直接持有業績兌現能力強的個股。
韓股此輪「去槓桿」反映散戶在半導體高β行情中，由追漲槓桿轉向挑選標的的精選操作。
paras_en: According to data from South Korea's Securities Depository Center SEIBRO, South Korean investors in US stocks sold a net $6.6439 billion worth of 3x Leveraged ETF (SOXL) on Monday, which is equivalent to 17.5% of the net buying of $37.8586 billion in July. Despite a net sale of $6.0735 billion over the first two days of the week, the trend of selling continued, with a net sale of $4563 million in the 3x Leveraged ETF (KORU) over the same period.
Market analysts believe that the price of SOXL rose to $200 in early July, only to drop below $100, and has since rebounded, prompting retail investors to take profits.

The funds did not leave the semiconductor sector, but instead shifted from leveraged ETFs to individual stocks. Over the first two trading days of the week, Micron Technology saw a net inflow of $1.4083 billion, followed by Western Digital with $1.4547 billion, and SK Hynix ADR with $9323 million (approximately 1.33 trillion won).

South Korean retail investors have not given up on their US stock strategy, with net buying of $6.33 billion in June, $46.69 billion in July, and $2.78 billion in August, marking three consecutive months of net inflows.

Analysts point out that leveraged ETFs are suitable for short-term trading and can erode profits due to volatility. As the HBM and AI memory market enters an upward phase, investors prefer to hold individual stocks with strong performance capabilities.
The 'de-leveraging' trend in South Korea reflects the shift of retail investors from chasing leveraged ETFs to selecting individual stocks in the high-beta semiconductor market.

items.title: 全球記憶體荒恐比預期更久！2027年產能已售罄 供應吃緊一路延至2028年
items.title_en: Global Memory Shortage May Last Longer Than Expected, 2027 Production Already Sold Out
paras: 全球記憶體供應危機持續升溫，AI 浪潮帶動資料中心大舉擴建，不僅推升高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 需求，也排擠傳統 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 產能，使整體市場供需失衡情況進一步惡化。
根據外媒引述產業消息指出，三星電子、SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 與美光 (Micron) 等主要記憶體供應商，已提前售罄 2027 年 DRAM 與 HBM 產能，市場普遍預期，供應緊張局面至少將持續至 2028 年。
報導指出，目前 AI 基礎建設投資仍快速增加，大型雲端服務供應商 (Hyperscaler) 及 AI 企業為確保未來供貨，已提前與記憶體廠簽訂長期供貨合約，甚至接受預付款模式鎖定產能。由於主要供應商將有限產能優先分配給大型客戶，中小型企業及消費性電子品牌未來取得記憶體的難度也將同步提高。
除了 DRAM 外，NAND Flash 市場供應同樣趨於緊俏。市場消息指出，今年主要 NAND 供應商的產能也陸續被預訂，其中三星、美光及 SanDisk 的年度產能已幾乎售罄，鎧俠 (Kioxia) 及 SK 海力士也預計在近期完成 2027 年供貨合約，使整體記憶體市場持續維持供不應求。
AI 需求排擠傳統市場 HBM 成為兵家必爭之地
這波記憶體供應危機，核心原因並非消費性電子需求突然大幅成長，而是 AI 資料中心對高效能記憶體的需求持續攀升。
相較於一般 DRAM，HBM 採用多層晶片堆疊與矽穿孔 (TSV) 封裝技術，可提供遠高於傳統 DRAM 的資料傳輸頻寬，是 AI GPU 及 AI 加速器不可或缺的核心元件。由於 HBM 單位售價與獲利能力遠高於一般 DRAM，記憶體廠也持續將更多產能投入 HBM 產品，進一步壓縮 PC、智慧手機及其他消費性電子產品可使用的 DRAM 供應。
市場人士指出，目前 AI 基礎建設建置速度仍遠快於新增產能速度，幾乎所有新增產能都被大型雲端業者優先吸收，也使一般市場持續面臨供應不足與價格上漲壓力。
新產能難快速到位 供需失衡短期難解
業界認為，供應緊張不易在短時間內改善，主因在於新晶圓廠建置需要相當長時間。
從興建新廠、設備進駐到正式量產，通常需要數年時間，若在美國設廠，因法規與建廠流程更為複雜，所需時間可能更長。雖然三星、美光及 SK 海力士目前都已啟動擴產計畫，但新增產能短期內仍不足以追上 AI 帶來的需求增速，因此市場普遍認為，至少未來兩年記憶體供需仍將維持緊繃。
此外，由於大型 AI 企業願意支付更高價格取得供貨，供應商自然也更傾向將有限產能優先分配至高毛利產品，使傳統消費性市場持續承受供貨不足壓力。
三大記憶體廠一致示警 2027 年恐成最吃緊一年
主要供應商近期對市場前景也抱持相當保守態度。
美光執行長 Sanjay Mehrotra 表示，即使公司持續擴充全球產能，目前仍無法預見供給何時能追上需求，AI 帶來的需求仍持續快速增加，供需缺口短期內難以消除。
三星電子則認為，2028 年前市場新增供給恐怕都難有明顯改善，今年尚未滿足的需求還可能延續至明年，使供應持續維持緊張狀態。
SK 海力士執行長郭魯正 (Kwak Noh-jung) 更直言，2027 年可能成為整個記憶體產業供應最緊張的一年，且即使放眼 2030 年之後，市場需求仍可能持續高於供給能力。
消費電子成本持續增加 iPhone、PC 都面臨壓力
隨著 AI 企業持續優先取得記憶體資源，智慧手機、PC 等消費性產品可取得的 DRAM 配額也可能逐年縮減。
市場預期，2027 年智慧手機與 PC 製造商採購記憶體的成本將進一步提高，終端產品價格也將面臨更大壓力。雖然大型品牌通常可透過長期採購合約降低部分衝擊，但仍難完全避開整體市場價格上漲趨勢。
蘋果同樣受到影響。雖然公司與供應商簽有長期合作協議，可在一定程度上減緩成本波動，但隨著整體記憶體價格持續攀升，市場普遍預期，今年秋季推出的新款 iPhone 仍可能因零組件成本增加而調整售價，未來若供應持續吃緊，價格壓力也可能延續至 2027 年。
蘋果評估更多供應來源 仍面臨政策限制
為降低供應風險，市場也傳出蘋果正評估更多記憶體採購來源，包括中國記憶體廠長鑫存儲 (CXMT)。
不過，CXMT 目前遭美國政府列入限制名單，美方認為其具有國安疑慮。若蘋果採用相關產品，可能影響未來美國政府採購資格，因此即使 CXMT 具備一定供應能力，蘋果仍須在供應鏈穩定與政策風險之間取得平衡。
科技股週三走勢分歧，美光 (MU-US) 小漲 0.06%，收 893.19 美元，但 SanDisk (SNDK-US) 重挫 5.40%，收每股 1,350.50 美元，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下滑超 2% 至每股 151.03 美元。
paras_en: The global memory supply crisis continues to escalate, driven by the AI wave and the rapid expansion of data centers. This not only drives up demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) but also squeezes out traditional DRAM and NAND Flash production, further exacerbating the market's supply-demand imbalance.

According to industry sources, major memory suppliers such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron have already sold out their 2027 DRAM and HBM production capacity, with the market expecting the supply tightness to continue at least until 2028.

Reports indicate that AI infrastructure investment is still increasing rapidly, with large cloud service providers (hyperscalers) and AI companies signing long-term supply agreements with memory manufacturers, even accepting prepayment models to secure production capacity. As major suppliers prioritize limited production capacity for large customers, small and medium-sized enterprises and consumer electronics brands will face increasing difficulties in obtaining memory in the future.

In addition to DRAM, the NAND Flash market is also experiencing tight supply. Industry sources indicate that major NAND suppliers' production capacity has been largely pre-booked, with Samsung, Micron, and SanDisk's annual production capacity almost sold out, while Kioxia and SK Hynix are expected to complete their 2027 supply contracts in the near future, maintaining the overall memory market's supply-demand imbalance.
AI demand has made HBM a battleground for traditional market players.
This memory supply crisis is not caused by a sudden surge in consumer electronics demand, but rather by the continuous increase in AI data center demand for high-performance memory.

Compared to general DRAM, HBM uses multi-layer chip stacking and silicon through-via (TSV) packaging technology to provide significantly higher data transmission bandwidth, making it an essential component for AI GPUs and AI accelerators. Due to HBM's higher unit price and profitability than general DRAM, memory manufacturers have continued to invest more production capacity in HBM products, further compressing PC, smartphone, and other consumer electronics products' DRAM supply.

Industry insiders point out that the current AI infrastructure construction speed is still far ahead of the addition of new production capacity, with almost all new production capacity being absorbed by large cloud service providers, leaving the general market to face ongoing supply shortages and price increases.
New production capacity is difficult to quickly come online, and the supply-demand imbalance is unlikely to be resolved in the short term.
Industry insiders believe that supply tightness is unlikely to improve in the short term, mainly due to the long time required to build new fabs and bring equipment online.

From building new factories to equipment installation and mass production, it typically takes several years. If a factory is built in the US, the process is even more complex, and the time required may be longer. Although Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix have already launched expansion plans, new production capacity is unlikely to catch up with the demand growth rate in the short term, and the market generally expects that the memory supply-demand situation will remain tight for at least the next two years.

In addition, since large AI companies are willing to pay higher prices to secure supply, suppliers naturally prioritize allocating limited production capacity to high-margin products, leaving traditional consumer markets to continue facing supply shortages.
The three major memory manufacturers have all issued warnings that 2027 may be the most challenging year.
Major suppliers have recently taken a conservative stance on market prospects.

Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra stated that even with ongoing global capacity expansion, the company cannot yet foresee when supply will catch up with demand, as AI-driven demand continues to grow rapidly, making it difficult to eliminate the supply-demand gap in the short term.

Samsung Electronics believes that it will be difficult to see significant improvements in market supply before 2028, and that this year's unsatisfied demand may continue into next year, maintaining the supply tightness.

SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung went further, stating that 2027 may be the most challenging year for the entire memory industry in terms of supply, and that even looking ahead to 2030, market demand may continue to exceed supply capacity.
Consumer electronics costs continue to rise, putting pressure on iPhone and PC prices.
As AI companies continue to prioritize memory resources, smartphone and PC manufacturers may face shrinking DRAM allocations year by year.

The market expects that the cost of purchasing memory for smartphones and PCs will continue to rise in 2027, and that end-product prices will face greater pressure. Although large brands can use long-term procurement agreements to mitigate some of the impact, they will still find it difficult to avoid the overall market trend of rising prices.

Apple is also affected. Although the company has long-term cooperation agreements with suppliers, which can help mitigate cost fluctuations to some extent, as the overall memory price continues to rise, the market generally expects that the new iPhone models to be released in the fall will still face price adjustments due to increased component costs, and that price pressure may continue into 2027.
Apple evaluates more memory supply sources, still faces policy restrictions.
To reduce supply risks, the market has heard that Apple is evaluating more memory procurement sources, including Chinese memory manufacturer CXMT.

However, CXMT is currently listed on the US government's restricted list, with the US government citing national security concerns. If Apple adopts related products, it may affect its future procurement eligibility, so even if CXMT has some supply capacity, Apple must balance supply chain stability and policy risks.
Tech stocks diverged on Wednesday, with Micron (MU-US) rising 0.06% to $893.19, while SanDisk (SNDK-US) plummeted 5.40% to $1,350.50, and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell over 2% to $151.03.

在人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮帶動下，記憶體等關鍵零組件需求遠高於供給。包括亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)等大型雲端服務商正投入數千億美元建設資料中心，推升相關硬體需求。

執行長 David Goeckeler 表示，Sandisk 以領先的技術產品組合完成 2026 會計年度，並將資料中心打造為核心成長動能，同時進一步深化與客戶的合作關係。
Sandisk 表示，自 4 月以來，在新的商業模式下已另外簽署五項協議，其中包括三家新客戶，以及兩項既有客戶的合作擴大案。

items.title: IonQ揭量子運算財報季序幕 營收暴增近4倍、上修全年財測
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，IonQ(QBTS-US)周三 (5 日) 率先揭開量子運算公司財報季序幕，執行長形容，這是公司「史上最強一季」。
總部位於美國馬里蘭州的 IonQ，近年已從量子運算拓展至量子網路與量子感測等相關技術領域。
公司 2026 會計年度第二季調整後每股虧損為 0.33 美元，優於分析師預估的虧損 0.56 美元。
真正亮點來自營收。第二季營收達 8,010 萬美元，較去年同期暴增近 4 倍，高於華爾街預估的 6,650 萬美元。管理層表示，營收大幅成長主要受惠於商業客戶對 Tempo 量子電腦需求增加，以及雲端運算服務需求持續強勁。
儘管營收大幅成長，IonQ 本季淨虧損仍擴大至約 19 億美元。公司調整後 EBITDA(稅息折舊及攤銷前) 虧損為 1.203 億美元，主要反映與 SkyWater Technologies(SKYT-US) 商業合作，以及收購交易相關成本。去年同期淨虧損與調整後 EBITDA 虧損分別為 1.775 億美元及 3,650 萬美元。
市場對此並不感到意外：IonQ 目前仍未獲利，儘管其技術持續獲得企業與政府客戶青睞。對目前的量子運算產業而言，獲利能力並非投資人最關心的指標，他們正等待本世代末有望成為市場催化劑的關鍵技術里程碑。
財報公布後，IonQ 盤後股價一度上漲約 2%。該股周三收盤下跌 2%。
市場反應偏正面，部分原因在於公司上調全年財測。IonQ 目前預估，2026 年全年營收將介於 2.8 億至 2.9 億美元，高於先前預估的 2.6 億至 2.7 億美元。分析師平均預估全年營收約 2.686 億美元。
為了在量子運算商業化前進一步提升競爭力，IonQ 近年積極透過併購擴大布局。上周完成對晶片製造商 SkyWater Technologies 價值 18 億美元的收購案。藉此將 SkyWater 旗下半導體晶圓代工能力納入，進一步掌握量子硬體供應鏈。
這項交易也正值美國政府進一步強化國內量子供應鏈之際。今年 5 月，包括 Rigetti Computing(RGTI-US) 及 D-Wave Quantum(QBTS-US) 等多家上市公司，已與美國商務部達成初步協議，以釋出部分股權換取聯邦政府資金支持。
雖然 IonQ 並未參與這項協議，但仍是美國政府的重要合作夥伴。執行長 Niccolo de Masi 於去年 7 月出席白宮量子創新峰會，進一步展現公司與美國聯邦政府之間的緊密合作關係。IonQ 去年底已成立專門服務政府客戶的事業部門。

items.title: 美禁中國光模組恐傷AI競爭力！研究：西方產能兩年內難補缺口
items.title_en: U.S. Ban on Chinese Optical Modules Could Hurt AI Competitiveness, Study Says Western Capacity Won't Fill Gap Within Two Years
paras: 美國擬限制中國光收發模組 (Optical Transceiver) 進口，引發市場看好美國供應商可望受惠，但最新研究指出，若禁令倉促上路，反而可能衝擊美國 AI 基礎建設發展。
根據外媒週三 (5 日) 報導，Counterpoint Research 警告，中國廠商目前掌握全球約六成至三分之二的光收發模組供應能力，西方廠商至少未來一至兩年內仍無法完全填補產能缺口。
Counterpoint 分析師 Neil Shah 表示，美國若迅速實施禁令，可能導致光模組供應不足，進一步推高建置成本、延後 AI 資料中心部署時程，甚至降低昂貴 AI 加速器 (Accelerator) 的使用效率，影響大型科技公司數千億美元的資本支出規畫。
Shah 指出，AWS、微軟 (MSFT-US)、Meta (META-US) 及 Alphabet (GOOG-US) 等超大規模雲端業者，未來都可能面臨 AI 叢集 (AI Cluster) 建設延誤的風險。他表示，若監管政策突然改變，恐造成硬體供應瓶頸，拖慢全球大型雲端服務商的 AI 部署進度。
此前，《路透》週二報導，美國總統川普政府正研擬禁止進口新的中國資料中心光收發模組，並希望聯邦通訊委員會 (FCC) 能在今年底前公布相關規範。不過，該措施目前仍在討論階段，內容仍可能修改，甚至取消。
光收發模組是 AI 資料中心的重要元件，負責將電子訊號轉換為光訊號，在光纖中高速傳輸資料。隨著 AI 超級叢集對 400G、800G 及 1.6T 高速互連需求快速提升，其重要性也持續增加。
Raymond James 指出，若禁令正式實施，美股上市公司 Coherent (COHR-US) 及 Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) 將是最直接受惠者，有望承接原本流向中國供應商的訂單。
不過，Counterpoint 認為，美國供應商短時間內仍難以完全接手。Shah 表示，Coherent 及 Lumentum 目前仍缺乏足夠的無塵室產能、自動化封裝能力及量產良率，至少未來 12 至 24 個月內，難以承接中際旭創 (Innolight) 及新易盛 (Eoptolink) 的龐大出貨規模。
受路透報導影響，中國光通訊族群周三全面走弱。海外營收占比高達 96% 的新易盛深圳股價一度重挫 10%；中際旭創 A 股及港股同步下跌約 8%；天孚通信 (Suzhou TFC Optical Communications) 跌約 6%，滬深 300 電信服務指數盤中一度下跌 9%。
相較之下，美國光通訊族群前一交易日大漲。Coherent 收漲 11%、Applied Optoelectronics 勁揚 18%、Lumentum 上漲 7%，市場預期若禁令落實，西方供應商將有機會獲得更多訂單。
Counterpoint 統計，中際旭創目前約占全球資料中心光收發模組營收 27%，2026 年第一季有 62% 營收來自美國市場；整體中國廠商則掌握約 60% 的全球資料中心光收發模組營收。
雖然中際旭創與新易盛近年均已將部分產能移往泰國，以降低美中貿易政策帶來的風險，但目前仍不清楚泰國生產的產品是否能豁免於未來禁令之外。
Shah 強調，將全球光收發模組市場簡單切割為「中國」與「非中國」兩個體系，並不符合產業實際運作模式。他指出，目前全球 AI 產業仍高度依賴中國光模組廠商的大規模製造能力。
此外，整體供應鏈本身也高度全球化。中國光模組廠商仍須採用博通 (AVGO-US)、Marvell (MRVL-US) 的數位訊號處理器 (DSP)，以及 Lumentum、Coherent 與三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 的雷射元件，因此任何禁令都可能擾亂整條高度整合的全球供應鏈，而非單純將市場一分為二。
值得注意的是，中際旭創甫於 7 月 30 日在香港完成約 68 億美元上市，為今年香港最大規模 IPO；該公司也於今年 6 月被美國國防部列入涉嫌與中國軍方有關聯企業名單。
目前 Applied Optoelectronics 是少數具備美國本土生產能力的主要供應商，並持續擴充產能。Raymond James 也認為，若 Coherent 未來決定投入相關投資，也具備在美國建立光收發模組產線的潛力。
paras_en: The United States is planning to restrict imports of Chinese optical transceiver modules, prompting market optimism that U.S. suppliers could benefit. However, a new study warns that a rushed ban could actually damage the development of U.S. AI infrastructure.

According to foreign media reports on Wednesday (the 5th), Counterpoint Research cautioned that Chinese manufacturers currently control roughly 60% to two‑thirds of global optical transceiver supply, and Western firms will be unable to fully close the capacity gap for at least one to two years.

Counterpoint analyst Neil Shah said that if the U.S. implements the ban quickly, it could create a shortage of optical modules, driving up build‑out costs, delaying AI data‑center deployments, and even reducing the efficiency of expensive AI accelerators—affecting the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar capital‑expenditure plans of large tech companies.

Shah noted that mega‑scale cloud providers such as AWS, Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US) and Alphabet (GOOG-US) could all face delays in constructing AI clusters. He warned that a sudden regulatory shift could create hardware supply bottlenecks and slow the AI rollout of the world’s biggest cloud operators.

Earlier, Reuters reported on Tuesday that the Trump administration was drafting a ban on new Chinese data‑center optical transceivers and hoped the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) would issue related rules by the end of the year. The measure is still under discussion and could be revised or dropped.

Optical transceiver modules are critical components of AI data centers, converting electrical signals to optical signals for high‑speed fiber transmission. As AI super‑clusters increase demand for 400G, 800G and 1.6T interconnects, their importance continues to grow.

Raymond James said that if the ban is enacted, U.S. listed companies Coherent (COHR-US) and Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI-US) would be the most direct beneficiaries, likely capturing orders that would otherwise go to Chinese suppliers.

Counterpoint, however, believes U.S. suppliers cannot take over the market in the short term. Shah explained that Coherent and Lumentum still lack sufficient clean‑room capacity, automated packaging capability and mass‑production yields, making it unlikely they can absorb the large shipment volumes of Innolight and Eoptolink for the next 12‑24 months.

Following Reuters’ report, Chinese optical‑communication stocks fell across the board on Wednesday. Shenzhen‑listed Eoptolink, which derives 96% of its revenue from overseas, saw its share price plunge about 10%; Innolight’s A‑shares and Hong Kong shares dropped roughly 8%; and TFC Optical Communications fell about 6%, while the CSI 300 Telecom Services Index slid as much as 9% intraday.

In contrast, U.S. optical‑communication stocks surged the previous trading day. Coherent rose 11%, Applied Optoelectronics jumped 18%, and Lumentum gained 7%, as the market anticipates that a ban would channel more orders to Western suppliers.

Counterpoint estimates that Innolight currently accounts for about 27% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue and that 62% of its Q1‑2026 revenue will come from the U.S.; overall, Chinese firms hold roughly 60% of global data‑center optical transceiver revenue.

Although Innolight and Eoptolink have shifted part of their production to Thailand in recent years to mitigate U.S.–China trade risks, it remains unclear whether Thai‑made products would be exempt from a future ban.

Shah emphasized that simply dividing the global optical transceiver market into “China” and “non‑China” segments does not reflect industry reality. He pointed out that the worldwide AI sector still heavily relies on the large‑scale manufacturing capacity of Chinese optical‑module makers.

Moreover, the supply chain is highly globalized. Chinese optical‑module firms still use Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Marvell (MRVL-US) digital signal processors, as well as lasers from Lumentum, Coherent and Mitsubishi Electric, meaning any ban could disrupt an integrated global supply chain rather than just split the market.

It is worth noting that Innolight completed a roughly $6.8 billion IPO in Hong Kong on July 30, the largest Hong Kong listing this year, and was added to a U.S. Department of Defense list in June of companies suspected of ties to the Chinese military.

Applied Optoelectronics is currently one of the few major suppliers with U.S. domestic production capability and is expanding capacity. Raymond James also believes that if Coherent decides to invest in the area, it has the potential to build an optical transceiver production line in the United States.

items.title: 馬斯克點名SpaceX全面導入輝達AI晶片 AMD慘崩超7%、輝達喜揚超3%
items.title_en: Musk Names AMD's Collapse and NVIDIA's Surge in AI Chip Market
paras: SpaceX 上市後首場財報法說會意外成為 AI 晶片市場焦點。執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布，未來 SpaceX 的 AI 基礎設施將全面採用輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，消息激勵輝達股價週三 (6 日) 收盤喜升逾 3%，AMD 則慘崩逾 7%。
馬斯克在法說會上表示，SpaceX 經過評估後，認為輝達的 Vera Rubin 架構是目前最優秀的 AI 運算平台，因此公司未來 AI 系統將「完全建立在輝達平台之上」，雙方也將持續深化合作。
他透露，SpaceX 預計今年底 AI 運算能力將突破 2GW，到 2027 年底進一步擴大至接近 10GW。公司也計畫自明年起部署 Starmind 衛星網路，並把輝達 Vera Rubin NVL72 機櫃系統同時應用於地面與太空資料中心。
馬斯克指出，相較於地面資料中心，太空資料中心不需大量土地，且可利用太空環境降低散熱需求，因此具備長期發展潛力。不過，如何將大型 AI 伺服器成功送入軌道並完成部署與連線，仍將面臨不小的技術挑戰。
SpaceX 同時公布最新 AI 業務表現。受惠於雲端服務合作案，以及 Grok 與 X 訂閱業務持續成長，公司 AI 業務營收達 26 億美元，較前一季大增 213%，年增 247%。
此外，SpaceX 已與 Google、Anthropic 簽署總額達數十億美元的資料中心租賃協議，未來將提供 AI 運算容量，支援兩家公司擴大人工智慧服務。
相較之下，AMD 雖繳出優於市場預期的第二季成績單，仍難掩市場失望情緒。
AMD 第二季營收 115.4 億美元、調整後每股盈餘 1.66 美元，均優於市場預估。其中，資料中心營收攀升至歷史新高 67 億美元，占總營收比重提高至 58%，主要受 EPYC 處理器與 Instinct AI GPU 出貨帶動；客戶端與遊戲事業營收則為 38.4 億美元，年增約 6%。
展望後市，AMD 預估第三季營收約 130 億美元 (上下浮動 3 億美元)，高於市場預估的 125.1 億美元，意味著年增約 41%、季增約 13%。
執行長蘇姿丰表示，公司下半年營運動能持續增強，EPYC 需求加速成長、Instinct 部署持續擴大，Helios 平台也將開始放量，AI 正推動各項運算需求快速提升。
她指出，AMD 近期已取得多項大型 AI 基礎設施合作案，包括 Anthropic、Meta 及 Core Scientific 等客戶，並將 2030 年 CPU 市場規模預估上修至超過 2,000 億美元，目標拿下逾 50% 市占率，同時預估明年伺服器業務營收將成長超過 70%。
部分華爾街分析師認為，儘管 AMD 展望依舊強勁，但市場原本期待公司在 AI 晶片業務能出現更快速的成長，因此財測未完全滿足投資人對短期爆發力的期待；再加上馬斯克宣布 SpaceX 將 AI 基礎設施全面轉向輝達，也進一步打擊市場情緒，拖累 AMD 股價大幅回落。
paras_en: SpaceX's first earnings call since going public unexpectedly became the focus of the AI chip market. CEO Elon Musk announced that SpaceX's AI infrastructure will fully adopt NVIDIA (NVDA-US) chips in the future, which sparked a surge of over 3% in NVIDIA's stock price on Wednesday (6th), while AMD plummeted over 7%.

Musk stated at the earnings call that after evaluation, SpaceX believes NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture is the most excellent AI computation platform currently, and the company's future AI systems will "completely be built on the NVIDIA platform", with both parties continuing to deepen their cooperation.

He revealed that SpaceX expects its AI computation capacity to break through 2GW by the end of the year and further expand to nearly 10GW by the end of 2027. The company also plans to deploy the Starmind satellite network from next year and apply the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 server system simultaneously to both ground and space data centers.

Musk pointed out that compared to ground data centers, space data centers do not require large amounts of land and can utilize the space environment to reduce heat dissipation requirements, thus having long-term development potential. However, how to successfully send large AI servers into orbit and complete deployment and connection will still face significant technical challenges.

SpaceX also announced its latest AI business performance. Benefiting from cloud service cooperation and the continued growth of Grok and X subscription businesses, the company's AI business revenue reached $2.6 billion, a 213% increase from the previous quarter and a 247% increase from the previous year.

In addition, SpaceX has signed a data center rental agreement with Google and Anthropic worth tens of billions of dollars, which will provide AI computation capacity to support the expansion of the two companies' artificial intelligence services.
In contrast, AMD, despite submitting a better-than-expected second-quarter earnings report, was unable to alleviate market disappointment.

AMD's second-quarter revenue was $11.54 billion, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.66, both of which were better than market estimates. Among them, data center revenue rose to a historical high of $6.7 billion, accounting for 58% of total revenue, mainly driven by the shipment of EPYC processors and Instinct AI GPUs; client and gaming business revenue was $3.84 billion, a 6% increase from the previous year.

Looking ahead, AMD estimates third-quarter revenue of approximately $13 billion (with a 3 billion dollar range), higher than market estimates of $12.51 billion, indicating a 41% increase from the previous year and a 13% increase from the previous quarter.

CEO Lisa Su stated that the company's second-half operating momentum will continue to strengthen, with EPYC demand accelerating growth, Instinct deployment continuing to expand, and the Helios platform starting to ramp up, with AI driving rapid increases in various computation demands.

She pointed out that AMD has recently secured several large-scale AI infrastructure cooperation agreements, including Anthropic, Meta, and Core Scientific, and will upgrade its 2030 CPU market size estimate to over $200 billion, aiming to capture over 50% market share, while also estimating that server business revenue will grow over 70% next year.

Some Wall Street analysts believe that although AMD's outlook remains strong, the market originally expected the company's AI chip business to show faster growth, and the earnings report did not fully meet investors' expectations for short-term explosive power; in addition, Musk's announcement that SpaceX will fully transition its AI infrastructure to NVIDIA has further dampened market sentiment, dragging AMD's stock price down sharply.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元跌至七周低點 荷姆茲海峽協議有望達成 日元持穩157
paras: 美元周三 (5 日) 走弱，跌至七周低點，市場期待華府與德黑蘭朝達成和平協議邁進。同時，日元走勢震盪，但仍遠高於上周美日聯手干預匯市前創下的 40 年低點。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.2%，報 99.68，創 6 月 16 日以來最低水準。
外匯市場焦點仍是日元。日元兌美元小幅走強，美元兌日元最新報 157.69，微幅下跌。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 本周稍早證實，美國已與日本共同進場買入日元，這是 2011 年以來雙方首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首度直接出手支撐日元。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助干預，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能對亞洲金融市場造成衝擊。
德意志銀行策略師 Jim Reid 表示，「我們的外匯策略團隊認為，日本央行 (BoJ) 必須加快升息步伐，才能讓日元出現更持久的回升。」
日本央行周三公布最新利率會議紀錄顯示，決策官員預期，中東衝突引發的油價衝擊，可能導致日本經濟成長放緩，同時推升通膨。
Reid 指出，「日本央行 6 月會議紀錄顯示，多位委員預期，本會計年度下半年消費者通膨將明顯升溫，八位委員中有兩位主張加快升息步伐。最新公布的日本薪資數據，也可能持續增加央行升息的壓力。」
經濟數據偏弱 美元續承壓
美國經濟數據也是市場焦點。根據 ADP，美國 7 月民間新增就業人數為 4.4 萬人，低於市場預估的 6.8 萬人，也較 6 月新增的 9.5 萬人放緩。
這項數據延續了周二公布的 6 月職缺數據所反映的降溫趨勢，也為周五將公布的 7 月非農就業報告提供參考。
儘管本周公布的勞動市場數據偏弱，但整體就業市場仍展現韌性，也支持聯準會 (Fed) 近期將政策重心重新放在控制通膨。
中東衝突導致油價波動，擾亂通膨走勢，也使聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
此外，美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 公布，7 月服務業 PMI 由 6 月的 54 升至 54.1，但略低於市場預估的 54.5。其中，衡量服務業企業支付原物料及投入成本變化的物價指數較 6 月進一步攀升，且近五個月已有四次高於 70，顯示成本壓力仍高。
市場期待荷姆茲海峽協議即將達成
中東局勢方面，包括美國總統川普在內，多位美國官員表示，重新開放荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 的重要協議已接近完成。
川普周二晚間向媒體表示，「事情進展得非常順利。我想 48 小時內就會知道結果。」
他並談到，「我們取得了很大進展。他們打電話給我說『拜託，我們談談吧。』他們希望展開對話。有趣的是，他們從來不提這件事…… 我認為，達成協議對他們來說會是非常明智的選擇。我們拭目以待。」
伊朗外交部則表示，德黑蘭與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽問題的談判仍在持續進行。外交部發言人 Esmaeil Baqaei 表示，只要「某些第三方」不加以阻撓，雙方聯合聲明目前已進入最終審閱與起草階段。
